title_en: Kitāb al-Ṣalāh of Abū Nuʿaym al-Faḍl ibn Dukayn
title_ar: الصلاة لأبي نعيم الفضل بن دكين

sections.title_en: Chapter on the Consecration of the Prayer (taḥrīm al-ṣalāh)

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ فَوْرَكٍ الْقَبَّابُ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ التَّيْمِيُّ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ الْفَضْلُ بْنُ دُكَيْنٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: 1 - حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْحَنَفِيَّةِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه، يَرْفَعُهُ قَالَ: «مِفْتَاحُ الصَّلَاةِ الطُّهُورُ، وَتَحْرِيمُهَا التَّكْبِيرُ، وَتَحْلِيلُهَا التَّسْلِيمُ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Bakr 'Abd Allah b. Muhammad b. Fawrak al-Qabbab informed us; he said: Abu Bakr 'Abd Allah b. Muhammad b. al-Nu'man al-Taymi informed us; he said: Abu Nu'aym al-Fadl b. Dukayn informed us; he said: Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Aqil, from Ibn al-Hanafiyya, from 'Ali (r), raising it (yarfa'uhu); he said:
entries.matn_en: “The key to prayer is purification; its consecration is the takbir, and its release (tahlil) is the taslim.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «تَحْرِيمُ الصَّلَاةِ التَّكْبِيرُ، وَتَحْلِيلُهَا التَّسْلِيمُ»
entries.isnad_en: Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu al-Ahwas, from 'Abd Allah, who said:
entries.matn_en: “The consecration of the prayer is the takbir, and its release is the taslim.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ: «إِنَّ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ شِعَارًا، وَشِعَارُ الصَّلَاةِ التَّكْبِيرُ»
entries.isnad_en: Mis'ar narrated to us, from 'Uthman, from Salim b. Abi al-Ja'd, who said: Abu al-Darda' said:
entries.matn_en: “Everything has a distinguishing mark (shi'ar), and the distinguishing mark of the prayer is the takbir.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on the Man Who Has Intercourse with His Wife While She Is Menstruating
sections.title_ar: بَابُ الرَّجُلِ يُجَامِعُ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: سُئِلَ سُفْيَانُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ، يُجَامِعُ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ، فَقَالَ: قَالَ الْأَعْمَشُ: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَا كَانُوا يَرَوْنَ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا الِاسْتِغْفَارَ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan was asked about the man who has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating, and he said: al-A'mash said, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “They did not consider that he owed anything except seeking forgiveness (istighfar).”

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Hisham, from Ibn Sirin,
entries.matn_en: the like of it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ: ⦗ص: 67⦘
entries.matn_ar: «لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ، يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَلَا يَعُودُ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu al-Ahwas narrated to us, from 'Ata' b. al-Sa'ib, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: [p. 67] “He owes nothing; he seeks God’s forgiveness and does not repeat it.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ يَعْمَرَ: عَلَيْهِ كَفَّارَةٌ؟ قَالَ: لَا، يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
entries.isnad_en: al-Qasim b. al-Walid narrated to us; he said:
entries.matn_en: I asked Ya'mar: Must he make an expiation (kaffara)? He said: No; he seeks God’s forgiveness.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ بَذِيمَةَ، عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فِي الَّذِي يَقَعُ عَلَى امْرَأَتِهِ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «نِصْفُ دِينَارٍ» .
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Ali b. Badhima, from Miqsam, from the Prophet ﷺ, concerning the man who falls upon his wife while she is menstruating; he said:
entries.matn_en: “Half a dinar.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ خُصَيْفٍ، عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم. ⦗ص: 68⦘
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Khusayf, from Miqsam, from the Prophet ﷺ.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: دِينَارٌ "
entries.isnad_en: [p. 68] Sufyan narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Layla, from 'Ata', from Ibn 'Abbas, who said:
entries.matn_en: A dinar.

sections.title_en: Chapter on What a Man May Have of His Wife While She Is Menstruating
sections.title_ar: بَابُ مَا لِلرَّجُلِ مِنِ امْرَأَتِهِ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْعُمَرِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَتْنَا الصَّهْبَاءُ بِنْتُ كَرِيمٍ، أَنَّهَا سَأَلَتْ عَائِشَةَ: مَا لِلرَّجُلِ مِنِ امْرَأَتِهِ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ؟ قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: كُلُّ شَيْءٍ مِنْهَا إِلَّا الْجِمَاعَ
entries.isnad_en: al-Hasan b. 'Ali al-'Umari narrated to us; he said: al-Sahba' bt. Karim narrated to us, that she asked 'A'isha: What may a man have of his wife while she is menstruating? She said:
entries.matn_en: “Everything of her except intercourse (jima').”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحِلٌّ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «يُبَاشِرُ الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ، يَكُونُ بَيْنَهُمَا إِزَارٌ» . ⦗ص: 70⦘
entries.isnad_en: Muhill narrated to us, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “A man may be in skin contact with his wife while she is menstruating, with a wrapper (izar) between them.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، قَالَ: سُئِلَ عَطَاءٌ قَالَ: مَا فَوْقَ الدَّمِ.
entries.isnad_en: Malik narrated to us; he said: 'Ata' was asked, and he said:
entries.matn_en: “What is above the blood.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ غَيْلَانَ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: لَا نَرَى بَأْسًا أَنْ يَضَعَهُ عَلَى الْفَرْجِ
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Ghaylan, from al-Hakam, who said:
entries.matn_en: We see no harm in his placing it on the pudenda (al-farj).

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ حَكِيمٍ الْأَثْرَمِ، عَنْ أَبِي تَمِيمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَنْ أَتَى حَائِضًا، أَوِ امْرَأَةً فِي دُبُرِهَا، أَوْ عَرَّافًا فَصَدَّقَهُ بِمَا يَقُولُ، فَقَدْ كَفَرَ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم»
entries.isnad_en: Hammad b. Salama narrated to us, from Hakim al-Athram, from Abu Tamima, from Abu Hurayra, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Whoever goes to a menstruating woman, or to a woman in her rear, or to a diviner ('arraf) and believes what he says, has disbelieved in what was sent down to Muhammad ﷺ.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هِلَالٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي شَيْبَةُ الرَّاسِبِيُّ، قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ سَالِمًا عَنِ الرَّجُلِ، يُضَاجِعُ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «أَمَّا نَحْنُ آلَ عُمَرَ فَنَهْجُرُهُنَّ إِذَا كُنَّ حُيَّضًا»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hilal narrated to us; he said: Shayba al-Rasibi narrated to me; he said: I asked Salim about the man who lies beside his wife while she is menstruating. He said:
entries.matn_en: “As for us, the family of 'Umar, we keep apart from them when they are menstruating.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَشْرَسُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ الْحَسَنَ قُلْتُ: أَيَنَامُ الرَّجُلُ مَعَ الْمَرْأَةِ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ؟ قَالَ: «يُلْقِي عَلَى وَرِكِهَا ثَوْبًا ثُمَّ يَنَامَانِ جَمِيعًا»
entries.isnad_en: Ashras b. 'Ubayd narrated to us; he said:
entries.matn_en: I asked al-Hasan: May a man sleep with a woman while she is menstruating? He said: “He throws a garment over her hips, and then the two of them sleep together.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا بَأْسَ أَنْ يَطْعَنَ، فِي سُرَّتِهَا، وَبَيْنَ فَخِذَيْهَا وَإِلْيَتَيْهَا» .
entries.isnad_en: Sharik narrated to us, from Layth, from Mujahid, who said:
entries.matn_en: “There is no harm in his thrusting at her navel, between her thighs and her buttocks.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: إِذَا كَفَّ الْقَذَى
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Isma'il, from al-Sha'bi, who said:
entries.matn_en: When the impurity (al-qadha) has ceased...

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي صَالِحُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، مِنْ أَهْلِ الشَّامِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: جِئْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه فَقُلْتُ: يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، مَا يَحِلُّ لِي مِنِ امْرَأَتِي وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ؟ قَالَ: «مَا فَوْقَ إِزَارِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Hisham b. Sa'd narrated to us; he said: Salih b. Jubayr narrated to me, from a man of the people of Syria, who said:
entries.matn_en: I came to 'Umar b. al-Khattab (r) and said: O Commander of the Faithful, what is lawful for me of my wife while she is menstruating? He said: “What is above her wrapper.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on the Woman Who Becomes Ritually Impure (junub) and Then Menstruates

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِنْدَلٌ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «تَغْتَسِلُ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَطْهُرَ»
entries.isnad_en: Mindal narrated to us, from Mughira, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “She performs the full ablution (ghusl) before she becomes pure.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِذْا ضَيَّعَتْ ثُمَّ حَاضَتْ قَضَتِ الصَّلَاةَ»
entries.isnad_en: Hasan narrated to us, from Mughira, from al-Sha'bi, who said:
entries.matn_en: “If she neglected [the prayer] and then menstruated, she makes up the prayer.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on the Menstruating Woman Who Sees Blood

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا طَهُرَتْ قَبْلَ غُرُوبِ الشَّمْسِ صَلَّتِ الظُّهْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ»
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us, from Jabir, from 'Amir, who said:
entries.matn_en: “If she becomes pure before sunset, she prays al-Zuhr and al-'Asr.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَرْبُوعٍ الْمَخْزُومِيِّ، عَنْ مَوْلًى لِعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا طَهُرَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ قَبْلَ غُرُوبِ الشَّمْسِ صَلَّتِ الظُّهْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ، وَإِذَا طَهُرَتْ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ صَلَّتِ الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ»
entries.isnad_en: Hatim b. Isma'il narrated to us, from Muhammad b. 'Uthman b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. Sa'id b. Yarbu' al-Makhzumi, from a client (mawla) of 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Awf, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Awf, who said:
entries.matn_en: “When a woman becomes pure before sunset, she prays al-Zuhr and al-'Asr; and when she becomes pure before the rising of dawn, she prays al-Maghrib and al-'Isha'.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: قَالَ الْحَسَنُ: قَالَ أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ: يَعْنِي الْحَسَنَ الْبَصْرِيَّ: لَيْسَ عَلَيْهَا إِلَّا الصَّلَاةُ الَّتِي طَهُرَتْ فِيهَا
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us; he said: al-Hasan said—Abu Nu'aym said: meaning al-Hasan al-Basri—:
entries.matn_en: “She is obliged only to pray the prayer in whose time she became pure.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَبِيبُ بْنُ أَبِي الْخَزِيرِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَتْنِي أُخْتِي، عَنْ أُمِّ الْخَزِيرِ، أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ فِي نِسْوَةٍ عِنْدَ عَائِشَةَ، فَقَالَتْ إِحْدَاهُنَّ: يَا أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، الْمَرْأَةُ ⦗ص: 77⦘ تَحِيضُ فِي الثَّوْبِ ثُمَّ تَطْهُرُ، أَتُصَلِّي فِيهِ؟ فَقَالَتْ: «إِنْ رَأَتْ دَمًا فَلْتَغْسِلْهُ، وَإِنْ لَمْ تَرَ دَمًا فَلْتَنْضَحْهُ سَبْعَ مِرَارٍ بِالْمَاءِ، ثُمَّ لَتُصَلِّي فِيهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Habib b. Abi al-Khazir narrated to us; he said: My sister narrated to me, from Umm al-Khazir, that she was among a group of women with 'A'isha, and one of them said:
entries.matn_en: “O Mother of the Believers, a woman menstruates [p. 77] in a garment and then becomes pure; may she pray in it?” She said: “If she sees blood, let her wash it; and if she sees no blood, let her sprinkle it seven times with water, then let her pray in it.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نُجَيْحٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from 'Ata',
entries.matn_en: the like of it.

sections.title_en: Chapter on What Makes the Full Ablution Obligatory

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ الدَّسْتُوَائِيُّ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا جَلَسَ بَيْنَ شُعَبِهَا ثُمَّ جَهَدَهَا، فَقَدْ وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ»
entries.isnad_en: Hisham al-Dastuwa'i narrated to us, from Qatada, from al-Hasan, from Abu Rafi', from Abu Hurayra, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: “When he sits between her limbs (shu'ab) and then exerts himself upon her, the full ablution has become obligatory.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ وَزَادَ فِيهِ:
entries.matn_ar: «وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ أَنْزَلَ أَوْ لَمْ يَنْزِلْ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Yunus, from al-Hasan, from the Prophet ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: the like of it, adding: “The full ablution has become obligatory, whether he ejaculated or not.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي عَوْنٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه: " إِذَا جَاوَزَ الْخِتَانُ الْخِتَانَ أَوْ قَالَ: مَسَّ الْخِتَانُ الْخِتَانَ وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ "
entries.isnad_en: Mis'ar narrated to us, from Abu 'Awn, from Ibn Abi Layla, who said: 'Umar (r) said:
entries.matn_en: “When the circumcised part passes the circumcised part—or he said: when the circumcised part touches the circumcised part—the full ablution has become obligatory.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ حَنْظَلَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ، رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا جَاوَزَ الْخِتَانُ الْخِتَانَ فَقَدْ وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Hanzala, from Salim, from Ibn 'Umar, from 'Umar (r), who said:
entries.matn_en: “When the circumcised part passes the circumcised part, the full ablution has become obligatory.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ غَالِبٍ أَبِي الْهُذَيْلِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيْمَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، رضي الله عنه مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Mis'ar narrated to us, from Ghalib Abu al-Hudhayl, from Ibrahim, from 'Ali (r),
entries.matn_en: the like of it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُطَرِّفُ بْنُ مَعْقِلٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الشَّعْبِيَّ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا جَاوَزَ الْخِتَانُ الْخِتَانَ فَقَدْ وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ»
entries.isnad_en: Mutarrif b. Ma'qil narrated to us; he said: I heard al-Sha'bi, from 'Ali (r), who said:
entries.matn_en: “When the circumcised part passes the circumcised part, the full ablution has become obligatory.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا جَاوَزَ الْخِتَانُ الْخِتَانَ فَقَدْ وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ»
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. Qays narrated to us, from 'Ali b. Rabi'a, from 'Ali (r), who said:
entries.matn_en: “When the circumcised part passes the circumcised part, the full ablution has become obligatory.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا مَسَّ الْخِتَانُ الْخِتَانَ فَقَدْ وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ»
entries.isnad_en: Mis'ar narrated to us, from Dawud b. Abi Hind, from al-Sha'bi, from Masruq, from 'A'isha, who said:
entries.matn_en: “When the circumcised part touches the circumcised part, the full ablution has become obligatory.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا طَلْحَةُ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا الْتَقَى الْخِتَانُ ⦗ص: 82⦘ فَقَدْ وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ»
entries.isnad_en: Talha narrated to us, from 'Ata', from 'A'isha, who said:
entries.matn_en: “When the circumcised parts meet, [p. 82] the full ablution has become obligatory.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَقِيلٍ الْحَذَّاءُ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَتْنِي بُهَيَّةُ، مَوْلَاةُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ قَالَتْ: سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ: مَا يُوجِبُ الْغُسْلَ؟ فَقَالَتْ: إِذَا الْتَقَى الْخِتَانَانِ فَقَدْ وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ
entries.isnad_en: Abu 'Aqil al-Hadhdha' narrated to us; he said: Buhayya, freedwoman of Abu Bakr, narrated to me; she said:
entries.matn_en: I asked 'A'isha: What makes the full ablution obligatory? She said: “When the two circumcised parts meet, the full ablution has become obligatory.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَلَاءُ بْنُ زُهَيْرٍ الْأَزْدِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الْأَسْوَدِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: دَخَلَتْ عَلَيَّ عَائِشَةُ فَقَالَتْ: «إِذَا الْتَقَى الْمَوَاسِيُّ فَقَدْ وَجَبَ ⦗ص: 83⦘ الْغُسْلُ»
entries.isnad_en: al-'Ala' b. Zuhayr al-Azdi narrated to us; he said: 'Abd al-Rahman b. al-Aswad narrated to me; he said:
entries.matn_en: 'A'isha came in to me and said: “When the razors meet, [p. 83] the full ablution has become obligatory.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَشْرَسُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ،: قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ الْحَسَنَ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ، يُجَامِعُ فَلَا يُنْزِلُ، قَالَ: «إِذَا جَلَسَ بَيْنَ فُرُوجِهَا الْأَرْبَعِ ثُمَّ اجْتَهَدَ فَقَدْ وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ashras b. 'Ubayd narrated to us; he said:
entries.matn_en: I asked al-Hasan about the man who has intercourse and does not ejaculate. He said: “When he sits between her four furuj and then exerts himself, the full ablution has become obligatory.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي رَجُلٌ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا غُسْلَ إِلَّا عَلَى مَنْ أَنْزَلَ الْمَاءَ» ⦗ص: 84⦘ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: لَيْسَ الْعَمَلُ عَلَيْهِ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna narrated to us, from 'Amr b. Dinar, who said: A man told me; he said: I heard Ibn 'Abbas say:
entries.matn_en: “There is no full ablution except for one who emits the fluid.” [p. 84] Abu Bakr said: The practice does not follow this.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: فِي الرَّجُلِ يُجَامِعُ فِي غَيْرِ الْفَرْجِ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: يَغْتَسِلُ وَيَغْسِلُ مَا أَصَابَهَا
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from al-Zubayr b. 'Adi, from Ibrahim, concerning the man who has intercourse outside the vulva (al-farj); he said:
entries.matn_en: “He performs the full ablution and washes what has touched her.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on the Man Who Has Intercourse and Then Repeats

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ مُحَارِبِ بْنِ دِثَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَنْ أَتَى أَهْلَهُ فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَعُودَ أَوِ الْمُعَاوَدَةَ فَلْيَتَوَضَّأْ»
entries.isnad_en: Mis'ar narrated to us, from Muharib b. Dithar, from Ibn 'Umar, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Whoever goes in to his wife and wishes to return to her—or [he said:] the repetition—let him perform ablution (wudu').”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ سَلْمَانَ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: بَنَى عَلِيٌّ، فَسَأَلْتُ عُمَرَ فَقَالَ: إِذَا جَامَعْتَ فَأَرَدْتَ أَنْ تَعُودَ فَتَوَضَّأَ وُضُوءَكَ لِلصَّلَاةِ
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Sulayman, from Abu 'Uthman, from Salman b. Rabi'a, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Ali consummated his marriage, and I asked 'Umar, and he said: “If you have had intercourse and wish to return, perform ablution as your ablution for the prayer.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ⦗ص: 86⦘ «كَانَ يَطُوفُ عَلَى نِسَائِهِ فِي غُسْلٍ وَاحِدٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Ma'mar, from Qatada, from Anas, that the Prophet ﷺ
entries.matn_en: [p. 86] “used to go around to his wives with a single full ablution.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُرَيْفُ بْنُ دِرْهَمٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قُلْتُ: أَحَدُنَا يُجَامِعُ أَهْلَهُ مِنْ أَوَّلِ اللَّيْلِ فَتَكُونُ فِي نَفْسِهِ الْمُعَاوَدَةُ، قَالَ: «يَتَطَهَّرُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Urayf b. Dirham narrated to us; he said:
entries.matn_en: I asked Ibrahim: One of us has intercourse with his wife at the beginning of the night, and he finds in himself the desire to return. He said: “He purifies himself.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on the Man Who Sleeps While in a State of Major Impurity (junub)

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ الْأَسْوَدَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ عَمَّا، حَدَّثَتْهُ عَائِشَةُ، عَنْ صَلَاةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: «كَانَ يَنَامُ أَوَّلَ اللَّيْلِ وَيُحْيِي آخِرَهُ، ثُمَّ إِنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ حَاجَةٌ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ قَضَى حَاجَتَهُ، ثُمَّ لَا يَمَسُّ مَاءً حَتَّى يَنَامَ»
entries.isnad_en: Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, who said: I asked al-Aswad b. Yazid about what 'A'isha had related to him concerning the prayer of the Prophet ﷺ. She said:
entries.matn_en: “He would sleep the first part of the night and keep the last part alive; then if he had a need of his wife he would fulfil his need, and then he would not touch water until he slept.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ مُصَرِّفٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «نَوْمَةٌ بَعْدَ الْجَنَابَةِ أَوْعَبُ لِخُرُوجِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Isra'il narrated to us, from Talha b. Musarrif, from Hudhayfa, who said:
entries.matn_en: “A sleep after janaba is more thorough for its departure.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَسْتَحِبُّ أَنْ يَنَامَ، نَوْمَةً بَعْدَ مَا يُجْنِبُ، وَقَالَ: هُوَ أَوْعَبُ لِخُرُوجِهِ
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim, from Abu Ma'mar, from Hudhayfa,
entries.matn_en: that he liked to take a sleep after becoming junub, and he said: It is more thorough for its departure.

sections.title_en: Chapter on Those Who Said: He Performs His Ablution for the Prayer
sections.title_ar: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: يَتَوَضَّأُ وضُوءَهُ لِلصَّلَاةِ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلَ عُمَرُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: إِنِّي تُصِيبُنِي الْجَنَابَةُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ؟ «فَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَغْسِلَ ذَكَرَهُ وَيَتَوَضَّأَ وَيَرْقُدَ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, who said: I heard Ibn 'Umar say:
entries.matn_en: 'Umar asked the Prophet ﷺ, saying: Janaba befalls me at night? “He ordered him to wash his penis, perform ablution and lie down to sleep.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْعُمَرِيُّ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ، رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَيَرْقُدُ أَحَدُنَا وَهُوَ جُنُبٌ؟ قَالَ: «نَعَمْ، إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ»
entries.isnad_en: al-'Umari narrated to us, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, from 'Umar (r), who said:
entries.matn_en: I said: O Messenger of God, may one of us lie down to sleep while in janaba? He said: “Yes, if he has performed ablution.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ الدَّسْتُوَائِيُّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ: أَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَرْقُدُ وَهُوَ جُنُبٌ؟ قَالَتْ: نَعَمْ، وَيَتَوَضَّأُ وضُوءَهُ لِلصَّلَاةِ
entries.isnad_en: Hisham al-Dastuwa'i narrated to us, from Yahya b. Abi Kathir, from Abu Salama, who said:
entries.matn_en: I asked 'A'isha: Did the Prophet ﷺ lie down to sleep while in janaba? She said: Yes, and he would perform his ablution for the prayer.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، ⦗ص: 92⦘ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Shayban narrated to us, from Yahya b. Abi Kathir, from Abu Salama, from 'A'isha, [p. 92] from the Prophet ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: the like of it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: إِذَا أَرَادَ الْجُنُبُ أَنْ يَنَامَ تَوَضَّأَ وضُوءَهُ لِلصَّلَاةِ.
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Salim b. Abi al-Ja'd, from 'Ali (r), who said:
entries.matn_en: When the person in janaba wishes to sleep, he performs his ablution for the prayer.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: يَتَوَضَّأُ وضُوءَهُ لِلصَّلَاةِ
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us, from Simak, from 'Ikrima, from Ibn 'Abbas, who said:
entries.matn_en: He performs his ablution for the prayer.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، (. . .) عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَنَامَ، تَوَضَّأَ» يَعْنِي الْجُنُبَ
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, (. . .) from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “When he wishes to sleep, he performs ablution”—meaning the person in janaba.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَشْرَسُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ الْحَسَنَ: أَيَنَامُ الرَّجُلُ مَعَ الْمَرْأَةِ وَهُوَ جُنُبٌ؟ قَالَ: «نَعَمْ، إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ وضُوءَهُ لِلصَّلَاةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us; he said: Ashras b. 'Ubayd narrated to us; he said:
entries.matn_en: I asked al-Hasan: May a man sleep with a woman while he is in janaba? He said: “Yes, if he has performed his ablution for the prayer.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَنَامَ وَهُوَ جُنُبٌ تَوَضَّأَ وضُوءَهُ لِلصَّلَاةِ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Salama, from 'A'isha, who said:
entries.matn_en: When the Messenger of God ﷺ wished to sleep while in janaba, he performed his ablution for the prayer.

sections.title_en: Chapter on the Person in Janāba Who Eats

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ الدَّسْتُوَائِيُّ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ،
entries.matn_ar: «فِي الْجُنُبِ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَطْعَمَ يَغْسِلُ يَدَيْهِ، وَيُمَضْمِضُ فَاهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Hisham al-Dastuwa'i narrated to us, from Qatada, from Sa'id b. al-Musayyab, concerning the person in janaba:
entries.matn_en: “When he wishes to eat, he washes his hands and rinses his mouth.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ زُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي الْجُنُبِ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ غَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ وَأَكَلَ وَشَرِبَ
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Zubayd, from Mujahid, concerning the person in janaba:
entries.matn_en: When he wishes to eat, he washes his hands, and he eats and drinks.

sections.title_en: Chapter on Those Who Said: He Performs Ablution

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا أَرَادَ الْجُنُبُ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ تَوَضَّأَ وضُوءَهُ لِلصَّلَاةَ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Salim b. Abi al-Ja'd, from 'Ali (r), who said:
entries.matn_en: “When the person in janaba wishes to eat, he performs his ablution for the prayer.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ، أَوْ يَشْرَبَ تَوَضَّأَ.
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from al-Zubayr b. 'Adi, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: When he wishes to eat or drink, he performs ablution.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ الدَّسْتُوَائِيُّ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: يَتَوَضَّأُ
entries.isnad_en: Hisham al-Dastuwa'i narrated to us, from Qatada, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr, who said:
entries.matn_en: He performs ablution.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ أَصْحَابَهُ، «كَانَ إِذَا أَجْنَبَ أَحَدُهُمْ لَمْ يَطْعَمْ طَعَامًا حَتَّى يَتَوَضَّأَ وضُوءَهُ لِلصَّلَاةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, that his companions
entries.matn_en: “when one of them became junub, would not eat any food until he had performed his ablution for the prayer.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on What Suffices of the Full Ablution

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ خَبَّابٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «يَغْتَسِلُ بِالصَّاعِ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Yunus b. Khabbab, from Mujahid, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ “used to perform the full ablution with a sa'.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي شَيْخٌ، مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ يُقَالُ لَهُ ابْنُ جَبْرٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم «يَغْتَسِلُ بِالصَّاعِ إِلَى خَمْسَةِ أَمْدَادٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Mis'ar narrated to us; he said: An old man of the Ansar called Ibn Jabr narrated to me; he said: I heard Anas b. Malik say:
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ “used to perform the full ablution with a sa', up to five mudds.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَلْدَةَ، عَنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ بْنِ دَارِمٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم «كَانَ يَغْتَسِلُ بِالصَّاعِ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Khalda narrated to us, from al-Musayyab b. Darim,
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet ﷺ “used to perform the full ablution with a sa'.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ جَابِرًا، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «يُجْزِئُ مِنْ غُسْلِ الْجُنُبِ صَاعٌ مِنْ مَاءٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Sharik narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. Muhammad b. 'Aqil, who said: I heard Jabir say:
entries.matn_en: “A sa' of water suffices for the full ablution of the person in janaba.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا بُكَيْرُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي عَدِيٌّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: يُجْزِئُ الْغُسْلَ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ صَاعٌ
entries.isnad_en: Bukayr b. 'Amir narrated to us; he said: 'Adi narrated to me; he said:
entries.matn_en: A sa' suffices for the full ablution from janaba.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: الْمَاءُ بِمِثْلِ الدُّهْنِ، مَا أَصَابَكَ مِنْهُ أَجْزَأَكَ
entries.isnad_en: Sharik narrated to us, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far, who said:
entries.matn_en: Water is like oil: whatever of it reaches you suffices you.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ،:
entries.matn_ar: «الْمَاءُ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الدُّهْنِ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far:
entries.matn_en: “Water is in the position of oil.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on What Suffices for Washing the Head

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنِ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ صُرَدٍ، عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: ذَكَرُوا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْغُسْلَ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ، فَقَالَ: «أَمَّا أَنَا فَأُفِيضُ عَلَى رَأْسِي ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ» وَقَالَ بِيَدِهِ هَكَذَا
entries.isnad_en: Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from Sulayman b. Surad, from Jubayr b. Mut'im, who said:
entries.matn_en: They mentioned in the presence of the Prophet ﷺ the full ablution from janaba, and he said: “As for me, I pour water over my head three times”—and he gestured with his hand like this.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا فُضَيْلُ بْنُ مَرْزُوقٍ، عَنْ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ: كَمْ يَكْفِي الْغَاسِلُ رَأْسَهُ، قَالَ: ثَلَاثُ حَفَنَاتٍ، وَجَمَعَ يَدَيْهِ، فَقَالَ: يَا أَبَا سَعِيدٍ، إِنِّي كَثِيرُ الشَّعْرِ، قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ⦗ص: 101⦘ أَكْثَرَ شَعَرًا مِنْكَ وَأَطْيَبَ
entries.isnad_en: Fudayl b. Marzuq narrated to us, from 'Atiyya, who said:
entries.matn_en: A man asked Abu Sa'id: How much suffices one who washes his head? He said: Three handfuls (hafanat)—and he joined his hands together. He said: O Abu Sa'id, I have a great deal of hair. He said: “The Messenger of God ﷺ [p. 101] had more hair than you, and was better.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ لِي جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: أَتَانِي ابْنُ عَمِّكَ - يُعَرِّضُ بِالْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ ابْنِ الْحَنَفِيَّةِ - فَقَالَ: كَيْفَ الْغُسْلُ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ؟ قَالَ: قُلْتُ: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْخُذُ ثَلَاثَةَ أَكُفٍّ فَيَفِيضُهَا عَلَى رَأْسِهِ، ثُمَّ يَفِيضُ عَلَى جِلْدِهِ» فَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ: إِنِّي رَجُلٌ كَثِيرُ الشَّعْرِ فَقَالَ: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَكْثَرَ شَعَرًا مِنْكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar b. Yahya narrated to us; he said: Abu Ja'far narrated to me; he said: Jabir b. 'Abd Allah said to me:
entries.matn_en: Your cousin came to me—alluding to al-Hasan b. Muhammad b. al-Hanafiyya—and said: How is the full ablution from janaba? I said: “The Messenger of God ﷺ would take three handfuls and pour them over his head, then pour water over his skin.” Al-Hasan b. Muhammad said: I am a man with a great deal of hair. He said: “The Messenger of God ﷺ had more hair than you.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَشْهَبَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا اغْتَسَلَ حَفَنَ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ ثَلَاثَ حَفَنَاتٍ
entries.isnad_en: Abu al-Ashhab narrated to us, from al-Hasan,
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet of God ﷺ, when he performed the full ablution, would scoop three handfuls over his head.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ الْأَخْنَسِ، عَنْ مَعْرُورِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه: «أَمَّا أَنَا فَآخُذُ ثَلَاثًا، أَوْ أَحْفَنُ ثَلَاثًا»
entries.isnad_en: Mis'ar narrated to us, from Bukayr b. al-Akhnas, from Ma'rur b. Suwayd, who said: 'Umar (r) said:
entries.matn_en: “As for me, I take three—or I scoop three.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَغْتَسِلُ مِنَ الْقَدَحِ وَهُوَ الْفَرَقُ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from 'Urwa, from 'A'isha, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ used to perform the full ablution from the bowl (qadah), which is the faraq.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْشَرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنِّي امْرَأَةٌ شَدِيدَةُ رِبَاطِ الرَّأْسِ أَفَأَنْقُضُهُ إِذَا اغْتَسَلْتُ؟ قَالَ: «لَا، يَكْفِيكِ تَصُبِّينَ عَلَيْهِ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Ma'shar narrated to us, from Sa'id, from Umm Salama, who said:
entries.matn_en: O Messenger of God, I am a woman who binds my hair very tightly; shall I undo it when I perform the full ablution? He said: “No; it suffices you to pour water over it three times.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَلَاءُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جَمِيعُ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ، - رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي تَيْمِ اللَّهِ - قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: دَخَلْتُ مَعَ خَالَتِي عَلَى عَائِشَةَ فَسَأَلَتْهَا - أَوْ قَالَ: ⦗ص: 104⦘ ذَكَرَتِ الْجَنَابَةَ -: «الرَّجُلُ يَكْفِيهِ ثَلَاثُ مَرَّاتٍ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ، وَالْمَرْأَةُ خَمْسٌ لِقُرُونِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: al-'Ala' b. Salih narrated to us; he said: Jami' b. 'Umayr—a man of Banu Taym Allah—narrated to us; he said:
entries.matn_en: I went in with my maternal aunt to 'A'isha, and she asked her—or he said: [p. 104] she mentioned janaba—: “For a man, three pourings over his head suffice; for a woman, five, for her braids.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي سُمَيٌّ، - مَوْلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ - قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: بَعَثَنِي الْقَعْقَاعُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ وَزَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ إِلَى سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ فَقُلْتُ: امْرَأَةٌ تَكُونُ جُنُبًا أَوْ حَائِضًا فَتَمْتَشِطُ، فَيُجْزِيهَا ذَلِكَ عَنْ غَسْلِ رَأْسِهَا؟ فَقَالَ: «نَعَمْ» ثُمَّ رَدُّونِي إِلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم؟ - فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ - قَالَ: فَأَخَذَ لِي قَبْضَةً مِنْ حَصْبَاءَ ثُمَّ قَالَ: «إِنِّي لَا أَكْذَبُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم»
entries.isnad_en: Hisham b. Sa'd narrated to us; he said: Sumayy—freedman of Abu Bakr—narrated to me; he said:
entries.matn_en: al-Qa'qa' b. Hakim and Zayd b. Aslam sent me to Sa'id b. al-Musayyab, and I said: A woman who is junub or menstruating combs her hair; does that suffice her for washing her head? He said: “Yes.” Then they sent me back to him and said: [Is that] from the Messenger of God ﷺ?—and he mentioned that—. He said: So he took for me a handful of pebbles and then said: “I do not lie about the Messenger of God ﷺ.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ جَابِرًا، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «يَغْرِفُ الْجُنُبُ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ ثَلَاثًا»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna narrated to us, from 'Amr b. Dinar, who said: I heard Jabir say:
entries.matn_en: “The person in janaba scoops three [handfuls] over his head.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «يُجْزِئُ الْجُنُبُ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ ثَلَاثًا»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna narrated to us, from 'Ubayd Allah b. Abi Yazid, who said: I heard Ibn 'Abbas say:
entries.matn_en: “Three [pourings] over his head suffice the person in janaba.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on the Person in Janāba Who Washes His Head with Marshmallow (khiṭmī)

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ، «كَانَ يَغْسِلُ رَأْسَهُ بِالْخِطْمِيِّ وَهُوَ جُنُبٌ، ثُمَّ يَغْتَسِلُ، وَلَا يَغْسِلُ رَأْسَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Hammad b. Salama narrated to us, from Sa'd b. Ibrahim, that Abu Salama
entries.matn_en: “used to wash his head with marshmallow while in janaba, then perform the full ablution without washing his head [again].”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا رَزِينٍ عَنِ الْجُنُبِ، يَغْسِلُ رَأْسَهُ بِالْخِطْمِيِّ فَقَالَ: «إِنْ كَانَ يَأْخُذُ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ، وَيُفْرِغُ فِي إِنَاءٍ، فَلَا بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us, from Mughira, who said:
entries.matn_en: I asked Abu Razin about the person in janaba who washes his head with marshmallow. He said: “If he takes from one vessel and pours into another vessel, there is no harm in that.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us, from Mughira, who said: I heard Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: the like of it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، رَضِيَ اللَّهُ ⦗ص: 107⦘ عَنْهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «أَيُّمَا جُنُبٍ غَسَلَ رَأْسَهُ بِالْغِسْلِ فَقَدْ أَبْلَغَ» وَقَالَ أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ: وَهُوَ الْخِطْمِيُّ
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Harith, from 'Ali (r) [p. 107], who said:
entries.matn_en: “Any person in janaba who washes his head with the washing agent (ghisl) has done enough.” And Abu Ishaq said: It is marshmallow.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَنْ غَسَلَ رَأْسَهُ بِغِسْلٍ وَهُوَ جُنُبٌ فَقَدْ أَبْلَغَ، وَلَا يَصُبُّ عَلَيْهِ مَاءً»
entries.isnad_en: Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Harith, from 'Ali (r), who said:
entries.matn_en: “Whoever washes his head with a washing agent (ghisl) while in janaba has done enough, and he does not pour water over it.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: مَرَرْتُ بِالْحَارِثِ بْنِ الْأَزْمَعِ فَقَالَ: أَلَا أُحَدِّثُكَ حَدِيثًا سَمِعْتُهُ مِنَ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، فَقَالَ: سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ: «أَيُّمَا جُنُبٍ غَسَلَ رَأْسَهُ بِالْخِطْمِيِّ فَقَدْ أَبْلَغَ» ⦗ص: 108⦘ قَالَ أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ: يَقُولُ: لَا يُعِيدُ عَلَيْهِ الْغُسْلَ
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, who said:
entries.matn_en: I passed by al-Harith b. al-Azma', and he said: Shall I not relate to you a hadith that I heard from Ibn Mas'ud? He said: I heard him say: “Any person in janaba who washes his head with marshmallow has done enough.” [p. 108] Abu Ishaq said: He means: he does not have to repeat the washing over it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ الْأَزْمَعِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَنْ غَسَلَ رَأْسَهُ بِالْخِطْمِيِّ وَهُوَ جُنُبٌ فَقَدْ أَبْلَغَ، وَلَا يَضُرُّهُ أَنْ لَا يَصُبَّ عَلَيْهِ الْمَاءَ»
entries.isnad_en: Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Harith b. al-Azma', from 'Abd Allah, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Whoever washes his head with marshmallow while in janaba has done enough, and it does not harm him not to pour water over it.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا يَضُرُّكَ بِأَيِّ جَانِبَيْ رَأْسِكَ بَدَأْتَ»
entries.isnad_en: Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Harith, from 'Ali (r), who said:
entries.matn_en: “It does not harm you with which side of your head you begin.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَغْسِلُ رَأْسَهُ بِالسِّدْرِ
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us, from Jabir, who said: I heard Abu Ja'far say:
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ used to wash his head with lote-leaf (sidr).

sections.title_en: Chapter on the Full Ablution from Janāba

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ ثُوَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " الْغُسْلُ مِنْ سِتَّةٍ: مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ، وَالْغُسْلُ مِنَ الْحَمَّامِ، وَالْغُسْلُ يَوْمَ الْعِيدَيْنِ، وَالْغُسْلُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ، وَالْغُسْلُ مِنَ الْحَيْضِ، وَالْغُسْلُ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us, from Thuwayr, from his father, from 'Ali (r), who said:
entries.matn_en: “The full ablution is for six: from janaba; the full ablution after the bathhouse (hammam); the full ablution on the day of the two festivals (al-'Idayn); the full ablution on the day of Friday; the full ablution from menstruation; and the full ablution from janaba.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ ثُوَيْرٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
entries.matn_ar: مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us, from Thuwayr, from Mujahid,
entries.matn_en: the like of that.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: «فِي كُلِّ شَعْرَةٍ جَنَابَةٌ، فَبُلُّوا الشَّعْرَ، وَأَنْقُوا الْبِشَرَ» ⦗ص: 110⦘ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: يَعْنِي تَحْتَ كُلِّ شَعْرَةٍ
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Yunus, from al-Hasan, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “In every hair there is janaba, so wet the hair and cleanse the skin (bashar).” [p. 110] Abu Bakr said: He means: beneath every hair.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سُئِلَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ، يَغْسِلُ رَأْسَهُ، ثُمَّ يَمْكُثُ سَاعَةً لَا يُحِبُّ أَنْ يُعْلَمَ بِهِ، ثُمَّ يَغْتَسِلُ، فَلَمْ يَرَ بِهِ بَأْسًا
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Mughira, who said:
entries.matn_en: Ibrahim was asked about a man who washes his head, then waits for a while, not wishing it to be known of him, and then performs the full ablution; he saw no harm in it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِنْدَلٌ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ أَبِي الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ⦗ص: 111⦘ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَوِ اغْتَسَلَ الْإِنْسَانُ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ فَبَقِيَتْ شَعْرَةٌ لَمْ تُصِبْهَا الْمَاءُ لَمْ يَزَلْ جُنُبًا حَتَّى يُصِيبَهَا الْمَاءُ»
entries.isnad_en: Mindal narrated to us, from Ja'far b. Abi al-Mughira, from Sa'id b. Jubayr, from [p. 111] Ibn 'Abbas, who said:
entries.matn_en: “If a person performs the full ablution from janaba and one hair remains that the water has not reached, he remains in janaba until the water reaches it.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْرَائِيلَ الْمُلَائِيُّ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِامْرَأَتِهِ وَرَآهَا تَغْتَسِلُ: «خَلِّلِيهِ، لَا تَخَلَّلُهُ نَارٌ قَلِيلٌ بُقْيَاهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Isra'il al-Mula'i narrated to us, from Talha, from Hudhayfa,
entries.matn_en: that he said to his wife, on seeing her perform the full ablution: “Run water between it (khallilihi), lest a fire run through it—[a fire] that leaves little remaining.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on Rinsing the Mouth and Sniffing Water into the Nose

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ بِنْتِ عَجْرَدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ،
entries.matn_ar: - فِي الرَّجُلِ يَغْتَسِلُ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ فَيَنْسَى الْمَضْمَضَةَ وَالِاسْتِنْشَاقَ - قَالَ: «يُعِيدُ» قَالَ أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ: يَعْنِي إِذَا صَلَّى
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hanifa narrated to us, from 'Uthman b. Rashid, from 'A'isha bt. 'Ajrad, from Ibn 'Abbas,
entries.matn_en: —concerning the man who performs the full ablution from janaba and forgets to rinse his mouth and sniff water into his nose—he said: “He repeats.” Abu Nu'aym said: He means, if he has prayed.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «أَمَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالِاسْتِنْشَاقِ فِي الْجَنَابَةِ ثَلَاثًا»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Khalid al-Hadhdha', who said:
entries.matn_en: “The Prophet ﷺ ordered sniffing water into the nose three times in [the full ablution from] janaba.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on the Full Ablution of the Man and the Woman

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ بُرْقَانَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: «كُنْتُ أَغْتَسِلُ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ وَهُوَ الْقَدَحُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ja'far b. Burqan narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from 'Urwa, from 'A'isha, who said:
entries.matn_en: “I used to perform the full ablution with the Messenger of God ﷺ from a single vessel, which was the bowl (qadah).”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْأَوْدِيِّ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحِمْيَرِيِّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي رَجُلٌ،
entries.matn_ar: صَحِبَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، كَمَا صَحِبَهُ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ أَرْبَعَ سِنِينَ قَالَ: نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ الْمَرْأَةُ بِفَضْلِ الرَّجُلِ أَوْ يَغْتَسِلَ الرَّجُلُ بِفَضْلِ الْمَرْأَةِ، وَلْيَأْخُذَا جَمِيعًا
entries.isnad_en: Abu 'Awana narrated to us, from Dawud b. 'Abd Allah al-Awdi, from Humayd b. 'Abd al-Rahman al-Himyari, who said:
entries.matn_en: A man who accompanied the Messenger of God ﷺ—as Abu Hurayra accompanied him, for four years—narrated to me; he said: The Messenger of God ﷺ forbade that a woman perform the full ablution with the leftover water of a man, or that a man perform the full ablution with the leftover water of a woman, and [said:] let both of them take [water] together.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: صَلَّيْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي رَمَضَانَ، فَقَامَ يَغْتَسِلُ فَسَتَرْتُهُ، فَفَضَلَتْ فَضْلَةٌ فِي الْإِنَاءِ، فَقَالَ: «إِنْ شِئْتَ فَأَرِقْهُ، وَإِنْ شِئْتَ فَصُبَّ عَلَيْكَ» قَالَ: قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هَذِهِ الْفَضْلَةُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا أَصُبُّ عَلَيْهِ، وَاغْتَسَلْتُ بِهِ وَسَتَرَنِي، فَقُلْتُ: لَا تَسْتُرْنِي، فَقَالَ: «بَلَى، لَأَسْتُرَنَّكَ كَمَا سَتَرْتَنِي»
entries.isnad_en: Zuhayr narrated to us, from Jabir, from Sa'd b. 'Ubayda, from Salama, from Hudhayfa, who said:
entries.matn_en: I prayed with the Prophet ﷺ in Ramadan, and he got up to perform the full ablution, and I screened him. A remnant was left in the vessel, and he said: “If you wish, pour it out; and if you wish, pour it over yourself.” He said: I said: O Messenger of God, this remnant is dearer to me than what I would pour over myself—and I performed the full ablution with it while he screened me. I said: Do not screen me! He said: “Indeed I shall screen you, as you screened me.”

sections.title_en: Chapter: Immersing in Water

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " يُجْزِئُ الْجُنُبُ أَنْ يَرْتَمِسَ الْمَاءَ.
entries.isnad_en: Sharik narrated to us, from Mughira, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “It suffices the person in janaba to immerse himself in water.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: مِثْلَهُ.
entries.isnad_en: Sharik narrated to us, from Jabir, from 'Amir,
entries.matn_en: the like of it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Sharik narrated to us, from Jabir, from 'Ata',
entries.matn_en: the like of it.

sections.title_en: Chapter on the Towel after the Full Ablution

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ سُوَيْدٍ،
entries.matn_ar: - مَوْلَى عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ - عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ، أَنَّهُ أَتَى عَلِيًّا رضي الله عنه وَقَدِ اغْتَسَلَ، فَأَخَذَ ثَوْبًا فَلَبِسَهُ - أَوْ قَالَ: دَخَلَ فِيهِ -
entries.isnad_en: Mis'ar narrated to us, from Suwayd—freedman of 'Amr b. Hurayth—from 'Amr b. Hurayth,
entries.matn_en: that he came to 'Ali (r) after he had performed the full ablution, and he took a garment and put it on—or he said: entered into it—.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فَقَالَ: لَا بَأْسَ بِالتَّنَشُّفِ فِي الثَّوْبِ
entries.isnad_en: Sharik narrated to us, from al-A'mash, who said:
entries.matn_en: I asked Ibrahim, and he said: There is no harm in drying oneself with a garment.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسٌ، عَنْ قَابُوسَ، عَنْ أَبِي ظَبْيَانَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: «لَا تَمَنْدُلَ لِلْوضُوءِ»
entries.isnad_en: Qays narrated to us, from Qabus, from Abu Zabyan, who said: Ibn 'Abbas said:
entries.matn_en: “There is to be no towel [-drying] after ablution (wudu').”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسٌ،، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «خَيْرُ مَا يَكُونُ الْمِنْدِيلُ فِي الشِّتَاءِ»
entries.isnad_en: Qays narrated to us, from 'Asim, from Bakr b. 'Abd Allah, who said:
entries.matn_en: “The best use of the towel is in winter.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ نُعْمَانَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ «تَوَضَّأَ، ثُمَّ دَعَا بِمِنْدِيلٍ فَتَمَسَّحَ بِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Qays narrated to us, from 'Abd al-Hamid b. Hurayth, from Yazid b. Nu'man, who said:
entries.matn_en: I saw Abu Ja'far “perform ablution, then call for a towel and wipe himself with it.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on the Man Who Has His Wife with Him

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ قُرَّةَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ أُنَاسًا، مِنْ بَنِي قُشَيْرٍ أَتَوُا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا: يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ، إِنَّا نَعْزِبُ وَمَعَنَا أَهْلُونَا وَلَيْسَ مَعَنَا مَاءٌ، فَنَأْتِي أَهْلَنَا؟ قَالَ: «نَعَمْ، وَإِنْ كَانَ إِلَى سَنَتَيْنِ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Bakr narrated to us, from al-A'mash, from Mu'awiya b. Qurra,
entries.matn_en: that some people of Banu Qushayr came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: O Prophet of God, we go off to the pastures with our families and we have no water; may we go in to our wives? He said: “Yes, even if it be for two years.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، مِنْ بَنِي عَقِيلٍ أَوْ بَنِي عَامِرٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ يَتَتَبَّعُ الْمَاءَ وَمَعَهُ أَهْلُهُ، فَيَمْكُثُ الْخَمْسَ وَالسِّتَّ لَيْسَ مَعَهُ مَاءٌ، يَأْتِي أَهْلَهُ وَيَتَيَمَّمُ بِالصَّعِيدِ
entries.isnad_en: Sharik narrated to us, from Khalid al-Hadhdha', from Abu Qilaba, from a man of Banu 'Uqayl or Banu 'Amir, who said:
entries.matn_en: He used to follow the water with his family, and he would stay five or six [days] with no water; he would go in to his wife and perform tayammum with clean earth (sa'id).

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: لَا بَأْسَ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ، الرَّجُلُ أَهْلَهَ وَلَيْسَ مَعَهُ مَاءٌ
entries.isnad_en: Sharik narrated to us, from Layth, from 'Ata', who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no harm in a man going in to his wife when he has no water.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: سَمِعْتُ سُفْيَانَ، سُئِلَ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ، يَكُونُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَلَيْسَ مَعَهُ مَاءٌ يَأْتِي أَهْلَهُ؟ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «نَعَمْ» قِيلَ: وَيَتَيَمَّمُ، قَالَ: «نَعَمْ»
entries.isnad_en: I heard Sufyan, when he was asked about the man who is on a journey and has no water: may he go in to his wife? He said:
entries.matn_en: “Yes.” It was said: And perform tayammum? He said: “Yes.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on the Man Who Dreams of Having Intercourse and Does Not Ejaculate
sections.title_ar: بَابُ الرَّجُلِ يُجَامِعُ فِي النَّوْمِ وَلَمْ يُنْزِلْ

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ: فِي الرَّجُلِ يَرَى فِي مَنَامِهِ أَنْ يُجَامِعَ وَلَا يُنْزِلُ، قَالَ: لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ
entries.isnad_en: Abu al-Ahwas narrated to us, from Mughira, from Ibrahim, who said, concerning the man who sees in his sleep that he is having intercourse and does not ejaculate; he said:
entries.matn_en: “He owes nothing.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ بُرْقَانَ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عِكْرِمَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «الْمَنِيُّ الْمَاءُ الدَّافِقُ - وَهُوَ الْجَنَابَةُ - وَفِيهِ الْغُسْلُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ja'far b. Burqan narrated to us; he said: I heard 'Ikrima say:
entries.matn_en: “Semen (mani) is the gushing fluid—and that is janaba—and for it there is the full ablution.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ الشَّنِّيُّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عِكْرِمَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «الْمَنِيُّ هُوَ الَّذِي يُغْتَسَلُ مِنْهُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Umar b. al-Walid al-Shanni narrated to us; he said: I heard 'Ikrima say:
entries.matn_en: “Semen is that from which one performs the full ablution.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on the Man Who Wakes Up and Finds Moisture
sections.title_ar: بَابُ الرَّجُلِ يَسْتَيْقِظُ وَهُوَ يَجِدُ بَلَلًا

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَيَّانَ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الشَّعْبِيَّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَ وَعَلَى ذَكَرِهِ بَلَلٌ فَلْيَغْتَسِلْ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Hayyan, who said: I heard al-Sha'bi say:
entries.matn_en: “If he wakes up and there is moisture on his penis, let him perform the full ablution.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيْمَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: يَغْتَسِلُ.
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: He performs the full ablution.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ:
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Ash'ath, from 'Ikrima, from Ibn 'Abbas, who said:
entries.matn_en: “He performs the full ablution.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: لَا يَغْتَسِلُ
entries.isnad_en: [p. 123] Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Mujahid, who said:
entries.matn_en: He does not perform the full ablution.

sections.title_en: Chapter on the Woman Who Sees in Her Sleep What a Man Sees
sections.title_ar: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ تَرَى فِي النَّوْمِ مَا يَرَى الرَّجُلُ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ النَّحْوِيُّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَتْ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَا تَقُولُ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تَرَى فِي المَنَامِ مَا يَرَى الرَّجُلُ؟ قَالَ: «إِذَا رَأَتِ الْمَاءَ فَلْتَغْتَسِلْ»
entries.isnad_en: Shayban al-Nahwi narrated to us, from Yahya b. Abi Kathir, from Ishaq b. 'Abd Allah b. Abi Talha, who said: Umm Salama said:
entries.matn_en: O Messenger of God, what do you say about the woman who sees in her sleep what a man sees? He said: “If she sees the water, let her perform the full ablution.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ رُفَيْعٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: دَخَلَتْ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، الْمَرْأَةُ تَرَى فِي الْمَنَامِ مَا يَرَى الرَّجُلُ، أَفَيَجِبُ عَلَيْهَا الْغُسْلُ؟ قَالَ: «هَلْ تَجِدُ الْمَاءَ؟» قَالَتْ: لَعَلَّهُ، قَالَ: «فَلْتَغْتَسِلْ» ⦗ص: 125⦘ قَالَ: فَلَقِيَتْهَا النِّسْوَةُ فَقَالَتْ: يَا أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ، فَضَحْتِنَا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ: مَا كُنْتُ أَنْتَهِي حَتَّى أَعْلَمَ أَفِي حِلٍّ أَنَا أَمْ فِي حَرَامٍ
entries.isnad_en: Abu al-Ahwas narrated to us, from 'Abd al-'Aziz b. Rufay', from Mujahid, who said:
entries.matn_en: Umm Sulaym came in to the Prophet ﷺ and said: O Messenger of God, a woman sees in her sleep what a man sees; is the full ablution obligatory for her? He said: “Does she find the water?” She said: Perhaps. He said: “Then let her perform the full ablution.” [p. 125] He said: Then the women met her and said: O Umm Sulaym, you have shamed us before the Messenger of God ﷺ! She said: I would not have stopped until I knew whether I was in what is lawful or in what is forbidden.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، قَالَ: الْمَرْأَةُ تَرَى فِي الْمَنَامِ مَا يَرَى الرَّجُلُ؟ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: «فَلْتَغْتَسِلْ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik b. Anas narrated to us, from Ibn Shihab, from 'Urwa, who said, concerning the woman who sees in her sleep what a man sees: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Let her perform the full ablution.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا رَأَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ فِي الْمَنَامِ مَا يَرَى الرَّجُلُ ثُمَّ أَنْزَلَتْ فَلْتَغْتَسِلْ»
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Harith, from 'Ali (r), who said:
entries.matn_en: “If a woman sees in her sleep what a man sees and then emits [fluid], let her perform the full ablution.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on How Long the Woman in Postpartum Bleeding (nufasāʾ) Sits Out [from Prayer]

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْأَعْلَى، عَنْ أَبِي سَهْلٍ،
entries.matn_ar: رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْبَصْرَةِ عَنْ مُسَّةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَتْ: «كَانَتِ النُّفَسَاءُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَقْعُدُ بَعْدَ نِفَاسِهَا أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا، أَوْ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً»
entries.isnad_en: Zuhayr narrated to us, from 'Ali b. 'Abd al-A'la, from Abu Sahl—a man of the people of Basra—from Mussa, from Umm Salama, who said:
entries.matn_en: “In the time of the Messenger of God ﷺ the woman in postpartum bleeding would sit out for forty days after her childbirth, or forty nights.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، عَنْ عُمَرَ، رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " تَجْلِسُ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً، ثُمَّ تَغْتَسِلُ ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us, from Jabir, from 'Abd Allah b. Yasar, from Sa'id b. al-Musayyab, from 'Umar (r), who said:
entries.matn_en: “She sits out forty nights, then performs the full ablution and prays.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَعْلَى بْنِ مُرَّةَ الثَّقَفِيِّ، عَنْ عَرْفَجَةَ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عَلِيًّا، رضي الله عنه يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا يَحِلُّ لَهَا إِذَا رَأَتِ ⦗ص: 128⦘ الطُّهْرَ إِلَّا أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ وَتُصَلِّي»
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us, from 'Umar b. 'Abd Allah b. Ya'la b. Murra al-Thaqafi, from 'Arfaja, who said: I heard 'Ali (r) say:
entries.matn_en: “It is not lawful for her, when she sees [p. 128] purity, [to do] anything but perform the full ablution and pray.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ إِيَاسٍ، عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ مَاهَكٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «تَجْلِسُ النُّفَسَاءُ نَحْوًا مِنْ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً» .
entries.isnad_en: Abu 'Awana narrated to us, from Ja'far b. Iyas, from Yusuf b. Mahak, from Ibn 'Abbas, who said:
entries.matn_en: “The woman in postpartum bleeding sits out about forty nights.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ أَبِي وَحْشِيَّةَ، عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ مَاهَكَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ:
entries.matn_ar: «تَقْعُدُ أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا» . ⦗ص: 129⦘
entries.isnad_en: Abu al-Rabi' narrated to us, from Ja'far b. Abi Wahshiyya, from Yusuf b. Mahak, from Ibn 'Abbas:
entries.matn_en: “She sits out forty days.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سِتِّينَ لَيْلَةً
entries.isnad_en: [p. 129] Sufyan narrated to us, from Layth, from al-Sha'bi, who said:
entries.matn_en: Sixty nights.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «النِّفَاسُ حَيْضٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, from 'Ata', who said:
entries.matn_en: “Postpartum bleeding is menstruation.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، أَظُنُّهُ عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ مَاعِزٍ، عَنِ الرَّبِيعِ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ، قَالَ: مَا لِلنُّفَسَاءِ عِنْدِي دَوَاءٌ مِثْلُ الرُّطَبِ
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us—I think [he said], from Bakr b. Ma'iz—from al-Rabi' b. Khuthaym, who said:
entries.matn_en: For the woman in postpartum bleeding I have no remedy like fresh dates (rutab).

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «كَانُوا يَسْتَحِبُّونَ لِلنُّفَسَاءِ الرُّطَبَ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “They used to recommend fresh dates for the woman in postpartum bleeding.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on the Person in Janāba Who Recites the Qurʾān

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَمْ يَكُنْ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَحْجُبُهُ شَيءٌ عَنِ الْقُرْآنِ إِلَّا الْجَنَابَةُ»
entries.isnad_en: Shu'ba narrated to us, from 'Amr b. Murra, from 'Abd Allah b. Salama, from 'Ali b. Abi Talib (r), who said:
entries.matn_en: “Nothing used to keep the Messenger of God ﷺ from the Qur'an except janaba.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَرِهَ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ وَهُوَ جُنُبٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from al-A'mash, from Abu Wa'il, from 'Ubayda, from 'Umar (r),
entries.matn_en: that he “disliked that one recite while in janaba.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ مَنْ، سَمِعَ عَلِيًّا، رضي الله عنه، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «اقْرَأِ الْقُرْآنَ مَا لَمْ تَكُنْ جُنُبًا، فَإِذَا كُنْتَ جُنُبًا فَلَا تَقْرَأْ مِنْهُ حَرْفًا، وَلَكِنِ اذْكُرِ اللَّهَ وَسَبِّحْ»
entries.isnad_en: Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from one who heard 'Ali (r), that he said:
entries.matn_en: “Recite the Qur'an as long as you are not in janaba; and if you are in janaba, do not recite a single letter of it, but remember God and glorify Him.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، رضي الله عنه،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَرِهَ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ وَهُوَ جُنُبٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Mis'ar narrated to us, from a man, from 'Amir, from 'Ali (r),
entries.matn_en: that he “disliked that one recite while in janaba.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِنْدَلٌ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا يَقْرَأُ الْجُنُبُ آيَةً تَامَّةً»
entries.isnad_en: Mindal narrated to us, from Mughira, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “The person in janaba does not recite a complete verse.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «الْجُنُبُ يُسَمِّي وَيَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from al-Mughira, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “The person in janaba may say ‘In the name of God’ and remember God Most High.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on the Person in Janāba Who Writes: “In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful” [Q. 1:1]
sections.title_ar: بَابُ الْجُنُبِ يَكْتُبُ: {بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ} [ الفاتحة: 1]

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ " كَرِهَ أَنْ يَكْتُبَ الْجُنُبُ: {بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ} [الفاتحة: 1] "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Layth, from Mujahid,
entries.matn_en: that he “disliked that the person in janaba write: ‘In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful’ [Q. 1:1].”

sections.title_en: Chapter on Tayammum with Clean Earth (ṣaʿīd)

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَ نَاجِيَةُ أَبَا إِسْحَاقَ، وَأَنَا مَعَهُ، قَالَ: تَمَارَى عَمَّارُ بْنُ يَاسِرٍ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ فِي التَّيَمُّمِ، فَقَالَ عَمَّارٌ: أَمَا تَذْكُرُ إِذْ كُنَّا نَتَنَاوَبُ رَعِيَّةَ الْإِبِلِ فَأَجْنَبْتُ، فَتَمَعَّكْتُ كَمَا يَتَمَعَّكُ الْبَعِيرُ وَالدَّابَّةُ، فَأَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ، فَضَحِكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَالَ: «إِنَّمَا كَانَ يَكْفِيكَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ التَّيَمُّمُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yunus b. Abi Ishaq narrated to us; he said: Najiya narrated to Abu Ishaq, while I was with him; he said:
entries.matn_en: 'Ammar b. Yasir and 'Abd Allah b. Mas'ud disputed about tayammum, and 'Ammar said: Do you not remember when we took turns tending the camels and I became junub, and I rolled about as a camel or a beast rolls; then I came to the Messenger of God ﷺ and mentioned that to him, and the Messenger of God ﷺ laughed and said: “It would only have sufficed you, for that, to perform tayammum.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَلَاءُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ، عَنْ زُبَيْدٍ،
entries.matn_ar: «أَنَّهُ كَانَ فِي سَفَرٍ فَأَصَابَتْهُ جَنَابَةٌ، فَلَمْ يَجِدْ مَاءً يَغْتَسِلُ بِهِ، وَأَنَّهُ تَيَمَّمَ بِالصَّعِيدِ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى» ، وَلَقِيَ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ، فَأَخْبَرَهُ كَيْفَ صَنَعَ، فَقَالَ: أَحْسَنْتَ (. . .)
entries.isnad_en: al-'Ala' b. 'Abd al-Karim narrated to us, from Zubayd,
entries.matn_en: “that he was on a journey and was afflicted with janaba, and found no water with which to perform the full ablution; and that he performed tayammum with clean earth and then prayed”; and afterwards he met Sa'id b. Jubayr and told him what he had done, and he said: You did well (. . .)

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: وَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ مَاءً فَلَا يَدَعِ التَّيَمُّمَ وَيُصَلِّي
entries.matn_en: “If he does not find water, he must not abandon tayammum, and he prays.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ، (. . .)
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ عَمَّارٌ: أَجْنَبْتُ وَأَنَا فِي الْإِبِلِ، فَلَمْ أَجِدِ الْمَاءَ، فَتَمَعَّكْتُ تَمَعُّكَ الدَّابَّةِ، فَلَقِيتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرْتُ، فَقَالَ: «إِنَّمَا يَكْفِيكَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ التَّيَمُّمُ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu al-Ahwas narrated to us, (. . .)
entries.matn_en: 'Ammar said: I became junub while I was with the camels and I found no water, so I rolled about as a beast rolls; then I met the Prophet ﷺ and told him, and he said: “It would only have sufficed you, for that, to perform tayammum.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَزْرَةُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ: إِنِّي أَصَابَتْنِي جَنَابَةٌ، وَإِنِّي تَمَعَّكْتُ فِي التُّرَابِ، فَقَالَ: أَصِرْتَ حِمَارًا " فَضَرَبَ يَدَهُ بِالْأَرْضِ، فَمَسَحَ وَجْهَهُ، ثُمَّ ضَرَبَ بِيَدِهِ الْأُخْرَى، فَمَسَحَ بِهَا يَدَيْهِ إِلَى الْمِرْفَقَيْنِ، فَقَالَ: هَكَذَا التَّيَمُّمُ "
entries.isnad_en: 'Azra b. Thabit narrated to us, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir, who said:
entries.matn_en: A man came and said: I was afflicted with janaba, and I rolled about in the dust. He said: “Have you become a donkey?” Then he struck the ground with his hand and wiped his face; then he struck with his other hand and wiped his hands to the elbows with it, and said: “This is how tayammum is done.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «تَيَمَّمْ مِنَ الْجَبَلِ وَالْكَلَأِ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Jabir, from al-Sha'bi, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Perform tayammum from the mountain and the herbage (kala').”

sections.title_en: Chapter on Those Who Did Not Hold Tayammum [to Be Valid]
sections.title_ar: بَابٌ فِي مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ التَّيَمُّمَ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: «لَوْ كُنْتُ جُنُبًا فَمَكَثْتُ شَهْرًا لَا أَجِدُ الْمَاءَ مَا صَلَّيْتُ حَتَّى أَجِدَ الْمَاءَ»
entries.isnad_en: Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu 'Ubayda, who said: 'Abd Allah said:
entries.matn_en: “If I were in janaba and stayed a month without finding water, I would not pray until I found water.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: «لَوْ أَجْنَبْتُ وَلَمْ أَجِدِ الْمَاءَ شَهْرًا لَمْ أَتَيَمَّمْ»
entries.isnad_en: Sharik narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu 'Ubayda, who said: 'Abd Allah said:
entries.matn_en: “If I became junub and did not find water for a month, I would not perform tayammum.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْشَرٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «أَقْبَلْنَا مِنَ الْغَابَةِ حَتَّى إِذَا كُنَّا بِمَرْبَدِ النَّعَمِ حَانَتِ الْعَصْرُ، فَتَيَمَّمَ وَصَلَّى ثُمَّ دَخَلَ الْمَدِينَةَ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Ma'shar narrated to us, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, who said:
entries.matn_en: “We were returning from al-Ghaba, and when we were at Mirbad al-Na'am the time of al-'Asr came; so he performed tayammum and prayed, and then entered Medina.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on the Time [Limit] for Tayammum

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَقْبَلْتُ مَعَ ابْنِ عُمَرَ مِنَ الْجُرْفِ، حَتَّى إِذَا بَلَغَ الْمِرْبَدَ يَمَّمَ وَجْهَهُ وَيَدَيْهِ إِلَى الْمِرْفَقَيْنِ
entries.isnad_en: Malik b. Anas narrated to us, from Nafi', who said:
entries.matn_en: I was returning with Ibn 'Umar from al-Jurf, and when he reached al-Mirbad he wiped his face and his hands to the elbows with earth (yammama).

sections.title_en: Chapter on Tayammum Being Two Strikes

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْعُمَرِيُّ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " التَّيَمُّمُ ضَرْبَتَانِ: ضَرْبَةٌ لِلْوَجْهِ، وَضَرْبَةٌ لِيَدَيْهِ إِلَى الْمِرْفَقَيْنِ "
entries.isnad_en: al-'Umari narrated to us, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, that he said:
entries.matn_en: “Tayammum is two strikes: one strike for the face and one strike for his hands to the elbows.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُبَارَكٌ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «التَّيَمُّمُ ضَرْبَتَانِ»
entries.isnad_en: Mubarak narrated to us, from al-Hasan, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Tayammum is two strikes.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَزْرَةُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " ضَرَبَ بِيَدِهِ الْأَرْضَ، فَمَسَحَ بِهَا وَجْهَهُ، ثُمَّ ضَرَبَ بِيَدِهِ الْأُخْرَى، فَمَسَحَ يَدَيْهِ إِلَى الْمِرْفَقَيْنِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: هَكَذَا التَّيَمُّمُ "
entries.isnad_en: 'Azra b. Thabit narrated to us, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir, who said:
entries.matn_en: “He struck the ground with his hand and wiped his face with it; then he struck with his other hand and wiped his hands to the elbows; then he said: ‘This is how tayammum is done.’”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَالِكٍ، عَنْ عَمَّارٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «التَّيَمُّمُ وَاحِدَةٌ، وَضَرَبَ بِيَدِهِ الْأَرْضَ، ثُمَّ مَسَحَ بِهِمَا يَدَيْهِ وَوَجْهَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Sharik narrated to us, from Husayn, from Abu Malik, from 'Ammar, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Tayammum is one [strike],” and he struck the ground with his hands, then wiped his hands and his face with them.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ لِي عَطَاءٌ فِي التَّيَمُّمِ: ⦗ص: 141⦘ «إِذَا مَسَحَ يَدَيْهِ بِالتُّرَابِ، فَلْيَمْسَحْ يَدَيْهِ وَوَجْهَهُ مَرَّةً»
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il b. 'Abd al-Malik narrated to us; he said: 'Ata' said to me concerning tayammum:
entries.matn_en: [p. 141] “When he has wiped his hands with the dust, let him wipe his hands and his face once.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَامِرٍ الْأَسْلَمِيُّ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ إِذَا تَيَمَّمَ يَمْسَحُ وَجْهَهُ مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَيَدَيْهِ إِلَى الْمِرْفَقَيْنِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd Allah b. 'Amir al-Aslami narrated to us, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar,
entries.matn_en: that when he performed tayammum he “would wipe his face once and his hands to the elbows.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، (. . .)
entries.matn_ar: رَجُلٌ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَغَسَلُوهُ، فَمَاتَ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «قَتَلُوهُ قَتَلَهُمُ اللَّهُ، أَوْ ضَيَّعُوهُ ضَيَّعَهُمُ اللَّهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Layth, (. . .)
entries.matn_en: a man, in the time of the Messenger of God ﷺ, and they washed him, and he died; and the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “They killed him—may God kill them—or they ruined him—may God ruin them.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الْأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «رُخِّصَ لِلْمَرِيضِ التَّيَمُّمُ، أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ كَانَ مَجْدُورًا كَأَنَّهُ صَمْغَةٌ، كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ؟»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Asim al-Ahwal, from Qatada, from Sa'id b. Jubayr, from Ibn 'Abbas, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Tayammum was made permissible for the sick person. Do you not see: if he had smallpox (majdur), as though he were [covered in] gum, what would he do?”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ الدَّسْتُوَائِيُّ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، فِي الْمَجْدُورِ تُصِيبُهُ الْجَنَابَةُ، قَالَ:
entries.isnad_en: Hisham al-Dastuwa'i narrated to us, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, concerning the person with smallpox who is afflicted with janaba; he said:
entries.matn_en: “He performs tayammum.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on One Who Performed Tayammum and Then Found Water
sections.title_ar: بَابُ مَنْ تَيَمَّمَ ثُمَّ وَجَدَ الْمَاءَ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، فِي رَجُلٍ تَيَمَّمَ ثُمَّ وَجَدَ الْمَاءَ فِي وَقْتٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا يُعِيدُ» يَعْنِي إِذَا صَلَّى
entries.isnad_en: al-Hasan narrated to us, from Mughira, from Ibrahim, concerning a man who performed tayammum and then found water while there was still time; he said:
entries.matn_en: “He does not repeat”—meaning, if he has prayed.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ شَيْبَةَ، قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ فَقَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا يُعِيدُ»
