entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna narrated to us, from 'Abd al-Hamid b. Jubayr b. Shayba, who said: I asked Abu Salama b. 'Abd al-Rahman, and he said:
entries.matn_en: “He does not repeat.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، قَالَ:
entries.isnad_en: al-Hasan narrated to us, from Layth, from Tawus, who said:
entries.matn_en: “He does not repeat.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، عَنِ الْعَلَاءِ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، قَالَ: يُعِيدُ
entries.isnad_en: [p. 145] al-Hasan narrated to us, from al-'Ala', from 'Ata', who said:
entries.matn_en: He repeats.

sections.title_en: Chapter on Eating Without Ablution

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْحُوَيْرِثِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنَّا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَدَخَلَ الْغَائِطَ، ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فَأُتِيَ بِطَعَامٍ، فَقِيلَ لَهُ: أَلَا تَوَضَّأُ؟ فَقَالَ: «أَأُصَلِّي فَأَتَوَضَّأُ؟»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna narrated to us, from 'Amr b. Dinar, from Sa'id b. al-Huwayrith, from Ibn 'Abbas, who said:
entries.matn_en: We were with the Prophet ﷺ, and he entered the privy, then came back, and food was brought to him. It was said to him: Will you not perform ablution? He said: “Am I about to pray, that I should perform ablution?”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: خَرَجَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه مِنَ الْخَلَاءِ، فَقُرِّبَ إِلَيْهِ طَعَامٌ، فَقِيلَ: أَلَا نَأْتِيكَ بِطَهُورٍ؟ فَقَالَ: أَخِّرْ عَنِّي طَهُورَكَ، فَإِنَّمَا قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ - أَظُنُّهُ - قَالَ: «أَسْتَطِيبُ بِشِمَالِي وَآكُلُ بِيَمِينِي»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan b. Sa'id narrated to us, from Hisham b. 'Urwa, from 'Urwa, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Umar (r) came out of the privy and food was brought near to him. It was said: Shall we not bring you water for purification? He said: “Put your purification behind me; for Abu Bakr said—I think—he said: ‘I cleanse myself with my left [hand] and eat with my right.’”

sections.title_en: Chapter on Recitation Without Ablution

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَمْ يَكُنْ يَحْجُبُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْقُرْآنِ شَيْءٌ إِلَّا الْجَنَابَةَ»
entries.isnad_en: Shu'ba narrated to us, from 'Amr b. Murra, from 'Abd Allah b. Salama, from 'Ali (r), who said:
entries.matn_en: “Nothing used to keep the Prophet ﷺ from the Qur'an except janaba.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ ثُوَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " رَأَيْتُ غُلَامًا يُمْسِكُ عَلَى عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه الْمُصْحَفَ، فَيَقْرَأُ، ثُمَّ يَقُومُ يَتَبَرَّزُ ثُمَّ يَجِيءُ، فَيَقْرَأُ وَمَا مَسَّ مَاءً
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us, from Thuwayr, from his father, who said:
entries.matn_en: “I saw a boy holding the mushaf for 'Ali (r) while he recited; then he stood up to relieve himself, then came back and recited, without having touched water.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «كَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ وَابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ يَقْرَآنِ وَهُمَا عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Hasan b. Salih narrated to us, from Salama b. Kuhayl, from Sa'id b. Jubayr, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Ibn 'Umar and Ibn 'Abbas used to recite while not in a state of ablution.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ مَنْ، سَمِعَ عَلِيًّا، رَضِيَ اللَّهُ ⦗ص: 148⦘ عَنْهُ يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «اقْرَأِ الْقُرْآنَ مَا لَمْ تَكُنْ جُنُبًا»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from one who heard 'Ali (r) [p. 148] say:
entries.matn_en: “Recite the Qur'an as long as you are not in janaba.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِنْدَلُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَرِهَ أَنْ تُمَسَّ الدَّرَاهِمُ، الَّتِي فِيهَا السُّورَةُ الْمَكْتُوبَةُ وَهُوَ عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Mindal b. 'Ali narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, from 'Ata',
entries.matn_en: that he “disliked that dirhams on which a sura is written be touched while one is not in a state of ablution.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on One Who Prays While Holding Back the Two Foul Things (al-akhbathayn): Excrement and Urine
sections.title_ar: بَابٌ فِي مَنْ صَلَّى وَهُوَ يُدَافِعُ الْأَخْبَثَيْنِ: الْغَائِطَ وَالْبَوْلَ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَا تُدَافِعِ الْأَخْبَثَيْنِ: الْغَائِطَ وَالْبَوْلَ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Layth, from Mujahid, from 'Umar, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Do not hold back the two foul things: excrement and urine.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَا أُبَالِي صَلَّيْتُ وَأَنَا أُدَافِعُ الْأَذَى، أَوْ كَانَ فِي ثَوْبِي»
entries.isnad_en: Sharik narrated to us, from Isma'il, from al-Hasan, from Ibn 'Abbas, who said:
entries.matn_en: “I would not mind praying while holding back the filth (adha), or if it were on my garment.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - فِي الْبَوْلِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ - قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: مَا لَمْ يُعْجِلْكَ.
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from al-Hasan b. 'Ubayd Allah, from Ibrahim—concerning [needing to] urinate during the prayer—; he said:
entries.matn_en: As long as it does not make you hasten.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، قَالَ: إِنَّا لَنَصُرُّهُ صَرًّا ⦗ص: 150⦘
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Ibrahim b. Maysara, from Tawus, who said:
entries.matn_en: We would tie it up tightly.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، قَالَ: إِنَّا لَنَضْغَطُهُ ضَغْطًا
entries.isnad_en: [p. 150] Muhammad b. Muslim narrated to us; he said: Ibrahim b. Maysara informed us, from Tawus, who said:
entries.matn_en: We would press it hard.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us, from Jabir, from Muhammad b. 'Ali, who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no harm in it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِنْدَلٌ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: إِذَا كَانَ لَا يُعْجِلُكَ فَلَا بَأْسَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ
entries.isnad_en: Mindal narrated to us, from Mughira, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: If it does not make you hasten, there is no harm in your praying.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us, from Jabir, from 'Ata', who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no harm in it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، قَالَ: إِنَّا لَنَصُرُّهُ صَرًّا
entries.isnad_en: And 'Abd al-Salam narrated to us, from Layth, from Tawus, who said:
entries.matn_en: We would tie it up tightly.

sections.title_en: Chapter on the Beginning of the Adhān

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: هَمَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْأَذَانِ حَتَّى نَقَسَ أَوْ كَادَ أَنْ يَنْقُسَ، قَالَ: «لَقَدْ هَمَمْتُ أَنْ آمُرَ رِجَالًا فَيَقُومُونَ عَلَى آطَامِ الْمَدِينَةِ فَيُؤَذِّنُونَ النَّاسَ» فَجَاءَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ زَيْدٍ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ رُؤْيَا، لَا إِنَّهَا عَنْ نَفْسِي، أُرِيتُ - إِنِّي لَمْ أَكُنْ نَائِمًا - رَجُلًا عَلَيْهِ بُرْدَانِ أَخْضَرَانِ قَائِمٌ عَلَى حَائِطِ الْمَسْجِدِ فَأَذَّنَ، قَالَ: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ مَرَّتَيْنِ، حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ، حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ، حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ، حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، ثُمَّ مَكَثَ - أَوْ جَلَسَ قَلِيلًا - ثُمَّ قَامَ فَقَالَ مِثْلَ قَوْلِهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: قَدْ قَامَتِ الصَّلَاةُ، فَقَالَ: «عَلِّمْهُنَّ بِلَالًا» قَالَ: فَأَذَّنَ بِلَالٌ، فَجَاءَ النَّاسُ سِرَاعًا، قَالَ: فَجَاءَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه، فَقَالَ: رَأَيْتُ الَّذِيَ طَافَ بِهِ، وَلَكِنَّهُ سَبَقَنِي إِلَيْهِ
entries.isnad_en: Qays b. al-Rabi' narrated to us, from 'Amr b. Murra, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Layla, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ was anxious about the call to prayer (adhan) until he sighed—or was about to sigh—and said: “I have been minded to order men to stand on the roofs of Medina and call the people.” Then 'Abd Allah b. Zayd came and said: I saw a vision—it is not from myself; I was shown—for I was not asleep—a man wearing two green cloaks standing on the wall of the mosque, and he gave the adhan. He said: God is greatest, God is greatest; I testify that there is no god but God, I testify that there is no god but God; I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of God—twice; come to prayer, come to prayer; come to success, come to success; God is greatest, God is greatest; there is no god but God. Then he waited—or sat for a little—then stood and said the like of what he had said, then said: The prayer has been established (qad qamat al-salah). He (the Prophet ﷺ) said: “Teach them to Bilal.” He said: So Bilal gave the adhan, and the people came hurrying. He said: Then 'Umar (r) came and said: I saw the one who went around with it, but he was ahead of me in it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: بَابُ: بَدْءِ الأذَانِ ⦗ص: 152⦘ 181 - حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ: كَانَ أَبُو مَحْذُورَةَ يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ» ، وَكَانَ بِلَالٌ يَقُولُ: «اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ» بِلَالٌ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَأَبُو مَحْذُورَةَ فِي الْحَضَرِ يَعْنِي: فِي آخِرِ الْأَذَانِ
entries.isnad_en: 'Isa b. al-Musayyab narrated to us, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: Abu Mahdhura used to say: “There is no god but God, and God is greatest,” and Bilal used to say: “God is greatest, God is greatest; there is no god but God”—Bilal on journeys and Abu Mahdhura when resident—meaning, at the end of the adhan.

sections.title_en: Chapter on the Merit of the Adhān

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمَاجِشُونِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي صَعْصَعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: إِذَا أَذَّنْتَ لِلصَّلَاةِ فَارْفَعْ صَوْتَكَ؛ فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَسْمَعُكَ إِنْسٌ وَلَا جِنٌّ وَلَا حَجَرٌ وَلَا شَيْءٌ مِنَ الْأَشْيَاءِ إِلَّا شَهِدَ لَكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-'Aziz b. al-Majishun narrated to us, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Sa'sa'a, from his father, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, who said:
entries.matn_en: When you give the adhan for prayer, raise your voice; for no human, no jinn, no stone and nothing at all hears you but it will bear witness for you on the Day of Resurrection.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْعَنْبَسِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: مَنْ أَذَّنَ فَلْيُسْمِعْ؛ فَإِنَّهُ يَشْهَدُ لَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَنِ انْتَهَى إِلَيْهِ صَوْتُهُ مِمَّنْ سَمِعَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Abu al-'Anbas narrated to us, from his father, from Abu Hurayra, who said:
entries.matn_en: Whoever gives the adhan, let him make himself heard; for whoever hears him, as far as his voice reaches, will bear witness for him on the Day of Resurrection.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَأَنْ أَقْوَى عَلَى الْأَذَانِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أَحُجَّ وَأَعْتَمِرَ وَأُجَاهِدَ»
entries.isnad_en: Sharik narrated to us, from Jabir, from 'Amir, from Sa'd, who said:
entries.matn_en: “That I should be strong enough to give the adhan is dearer to me than that I should perform the pilgrimage (hajj), the lesser pilgrimage ('umra) and fight in jihad.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي مَنْ سَمِعَ ابْنَ الْحَنَفِيَّةِ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «الْمُؤَذِّنُ الْمُحْتَسِبُ كَالشَّاهِرِ سَيْفَهُ» يَعْنِي فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
entries.isnad_en: Sharik narrated to us, from Jabir, who said: One who heard Ibn al-Hanafiyya say narrated to me:
entries.matn_en: “The mu’adhdhin who seeks reward from God (muhtasib) is like one who draws his sword”—meaning, in the path of God.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ سَابِطٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " تُفْتَحُ أَبْوَابُ السَّمَاءِ لِخَمْسٍ: لِنُزُولِ الْغَيْثِ، وَقِرَاءَةِ الْقُرْآنِ، وَلُقِيِّ الزَّحْفِ، وَالنِّدَاءِ بِالصَّلَاةِ، وَالدُّعَاءِ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Layth, from Ibn Sabit, who said:
entries.matn_en: “The gates of heaven are opened for five: for the coming down of rain, the recitation of the Qur'an, the meeting of the advancing [enemy] ranks, the call to prayer, and supplication.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَصَّافِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه: «لَوْ كُنْتُ مُؤَذِّنًا مَا بَالَيْتُ أَنْ لَا أَحُجَّ وَلَا أَعْتَمِرَ إِلَّا حَجَّةَ الْإِسْلَامِ»
entries.isnad_en: al-Wassafi narrated to us, from Abu Ma'shar, who said: 'Umar (r) said:
entries.matn_en: “If I were a mu’adhdhin I would not mind not performing the pilgrimage or the lesser pilgrimage, except the pilgrimage of Islam.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَصَّافِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه: «لَوْ كَانَتِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ نِزَالًا فِي الْأَرْضِ مَا غَلَبَهُنَّ أَحَدٌ عَلَى الْأَذَانِ»
entries.isnad_en: al-Wassafi narrated to us, from Abu Ma'shar, who said: 'Umar (r) said:
entries.matn_en: “If the angels were dwelling on earth, no one would surpass them in the adhan.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُبَارَكٌ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه: لَا يَسْتَحِي رَجُلٌ أَنْ يَكُونَ مُؤَذِّنًا
entries.isnad_en: Mubarak narrated to us, from al-Hasan, who said: 'Umar (r) said:
entries.matn_en: A man should not be ashamed to be a mu’adhdhin.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَصَّافِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ عُمَرُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: «إِنَّهَا مُحَرَّمَةٌ عَلَى النَّارِ لُحُومُ الْمُؤَذِّنِينَ»
entries.isnad_en: al-Wassafi narrated to us, from Abu Ma'shar, who said: 'Umar said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “The flesh of the mu’adhdhins is forbidden to the Fire.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَصَّافِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ: " نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآيَةُ فِي الْمُؤَذِّنِينَ: {وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ قَوْلًا مِمَّنْ دَعَا إِلَى اللَّهِ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا} [فصلت: 33] فَأَذَّنَ وَصَلَّى فَهُوَ عَمِلٌ صَالِحٌ
entries.isnad_en: al-Wassafi narrated to us; he said: Muhammad b. Nafi' narrated to us; he said: 'A'isha said:
entries.matn_en: “This verse was revealed concerning the mu’adhdhins: ‘And who is better in speech than one who calls to God and does righteous deeds’ [Q. 41:33]; so he gave the adhan and prayed, and that is a righteous deed.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي سِنَانٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي الْهُذَيْلِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه: لَوْلَا أَنْ أَخَافَ أَنْ تَكُونَ سُنَّةً مَا تَرَكْتُ الْأَذَانَ "
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us, from Abu Sinan, from 'Abd Allah b. Abi al-Hudhayl, who said: 'Umar (r) said:
entries.matn_en: If I did not fear that it would become a sunna, I would not leave the adhan.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، عَنْ بَيَانٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه: «لَوْ أَطَقْتُ الْأَذَانَ بِالْخِلِّيفَى لَأَذَّنْتُ»
entries.isnad_en: al-Hasan narrated to us, from Bayan, from Qays b. Abi Hazim, who said: 'Umar (r) said:
entries.matn_en: “If I were able to give the adhan along with the caliphate (al-khilliyfa), I would give the adhan.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا دَلْهَمُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي عَوْنُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ، فَحَانَتِ الصَّلَاةُ، فَسَمِعَ رَجُلًا يَقُولُ: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «الْفِطْرَةُ» فَقَالَ: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، قَالَ: «خَلَعَ الْأَنْدَادَ» قَالَ: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: «دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ» ثُمَّ صَلَّى بِإِقَامَتِهِ وَهُوَ لَا يَرَاهُ
entries.isnad_en: Dalham b. Salih narrated to us; he said: 'Awn b. 'Abd Allah informed me; he said:
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ went out one day from Medina, and the time of prayer came, and he heard a man say: God is greatest. The Prophet ﷺ said: “The natural disposition (al-fitra).” He said: I testify that there is no god but God. He said: “He has cast off the equals [set up with God].” He said: I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of God. He said: “He has entered Paradise.” Then he prayed with his iqama, though the man did not see him.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسٌ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانُوا يَسْتَحِبُّونَ أَنْ يَكُونَ مُؤَذِّنِيهُمْ فُقَهَاؤُهُمْ؛ لِأَنَّهُمْ وَلُّوهُمْ أَمَرَ دِينِهِمْ
entries.isnad_en: Qays narrated to us, from Abu Hamza, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: They used to like their mu’adhdhins to be their jurists, because they had put them in charge of the matter of their religion.

sections.title_en: Chapter on What Is Said When the Mu’adhdhin Gives the Adhān
sections.title_ar: بَابُ مَا يُقَالُ إِذَا أَذَّنَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: يَعْنِي ابْنَ حُسَيْنٍ عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، قَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم " إِذَا سَمِعَ الْمُؤَذِّنَ قَالَ كَمَا يَقُولُ: حَتَّى إِذَا بَلَغَ: حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ، حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ، قَالَ: «لَا حَولَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Sharik narrated to us, from 'Asim b. 'Ubayd Allah, from 'Ali—Abu Bakr said: meaning Ibn Husayn—from Abu Rafi', who said:
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ “when he heard the mu’adhdhin, would say as he said, until, when he reached: ‘Come to prayer, come to success,’ he said: ‘There is no power and no strength except in God.’”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مِنَ الْجَفَاءِ أَنْ لَا تَقُولَ مِثْلَ مَا يَقُولُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ»
entries.isnad_en: Sharik narrated to us, from 'Asim, from al-Musayyab b. Rafi', from 'Abd Allah, who said:
entries.matn_en: “It is among the coarseness (jafa') not to say the like of what the mu’adhdhin says.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا سَمِعَ الْمُؤَذِّنَ قَالَ: «وَأَنَا وَأَنَا»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Hisham b. 'Urwa, who said:
entries.matn_en: “The Prophet ﷺ, when he heard the mu’adhdhin, would say: ‘And I, and I.’”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ ذَرٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ حَفْصِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم هَبَطَ مِنْ مَدَارِجِ التَّمْرِ بَيْنَ مَكَّةَ وَالْمَدِينَةِ، فَعَرَّسَ، فَأَذَّنَ بِلَالٌ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَنْ قَالَ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ بِلَالٌ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ حَرَّمَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى النَّارِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Umar b. Dharr narrated to us, from Abu Bakr b. Hafs b. 'Umar b. Sa'd,
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God ﷺ came down from Madarij al-Tamr between Mecca and Medina and made a night camp, and Bilal gave the adhan; and the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Whoever says the like of what Bilal said, from himself (min nafsihi), God will forbid him to the Fire.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُجَمِّعُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو أُمَامَةَ بْنُ سَهْلِ بْنِ حَنِيفٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا كَبَّرَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ اثْنَتَيْنِ فَكَبِّرِ اثْنَتَيْنِ، وَإِذَا شَهِدَ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ اثْنَتَيْنِ اشْهَدِ اثْنَتَيْنِ، وَإِذَا شَهِدَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ اثْنَتَيْنِ اشْهَدِ اثْنَتَيْنِ» ، ثُمَّ الْتَفَتَ إِلَيَّ فَقَالَ: هَكَذَا سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ عِنْدَ الْأَذَانِ
entries.isnad_en: Mujammi' b. Yahya narrated to us; he said: Abu Umama b. Sahl b. Hunayf narrated to me; he said: I heard Mu'awiya say:
entries.matn_en: “When the mu’adhdhin says the takbir twice, say the takbir twice; and when he testifies that there is no god but God twice, testify twice; and when he testifies that Muhammad is the Messenger of God twice, testify twice.” Then he turned to me and said: Thus I heard the Prophet ﷺ say at the adhan.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا سَمِعَ الْمُنَادِيَ يَقُولُ: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، قَالَ: «وَأَنَا وَأَنَا» وَإِذَا قَالَ: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: «وَأَنَا» ثُمَّ سَكَتَ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna narrated to us, from 'Amr, from Abu Ja'far, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ, when he heard the caller say: “I testify that there is no god but God,” said: “And I, and I”; and when he said: “I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of God,” he said: “And I”; then he fell silent.

sections.title_en: Chapter on Taking Payment for the Adhān

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ يُقَالُ: " أَرْبَعُ لَا يُؤْخَذُ عَلَيْهِنَّ رِزْقًا: الْقُرْآنُ، وَالْأَذَانُ، وَالْقَضَاءُ، وَالْمَقَاسِمُ "
entries.isnad_en: al-Mas'udi narrated to us, from al-Qasim, who said:
entries.matn_en: It used to be said: “Four things for which no stipend is taken: the Qur'an, the adhan, judging (qada'), and the division of shares (maqasim).”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَارَةُ بْنُ زَاذَانَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى الْبُكَّاءِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنْتُ أَطُوفُ مَعَ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، وَهُوَ آخِذٌ بِيَدِي، فَمَرَّ ابْنُ عُمَرَ، فَاسْتَقْبَلَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ مُؤَذِّنِي الْكَعْبَةَ، فَقَالَ: إِنِّي لَأُبْغضُكَ فِي اللَّهِ قَالَ: إِنَّهُ يُحَسِّنُ صَوْتَهُ؛ لِأَخْذِ الدَّرَاهِمِ
entries.isnad_en: 'Umara b. Zadhan narrated to us, from Yahya al-Bakka', who said:
entries.matn_en: I was circumambulating with Sa'id b. Jubayr, who was holding my hand, when Ibn 'Umar passed, and a man from among the mu’adhdhins of the Ka'ba met him, and he said: I hate you for God’s sake. He said: He beautifies his voice in order to take dirhams.

sections.title_en: Chapter on the Adhān of the Blind Man, and Those Who Disliked It and Those Who Permitted It
sections.title_ar: بَابُ أَذَانِ الْأَعْمَى وَمَنْ كَرِهَهُ وَمَنْ رَخَّصَ فِيهِ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ وَاصِلٍ الْأَحْدَبِ، عَنْ قَبِيصَةَ بْنِ بُرْمَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: " مَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ يَكُونَ مُؤَذِّنُوكُمْ عِمْيَانَكُمْ، قَالَ: وَأَحْسِبُهُ قَالَ: وَلَا قُرَّاؤُكُمْ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Wasil al-Ahdab, from Qabisa b. Burma, who said: 'Abd Allah said:
entries.matn_en: “I do not like your mu’adhdhins to be your blind men”—he (Qabisa) said: and I think he said: “nor your reciters (qurra').”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمَاجِشُونِ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: «إِنَّ بِلَالًا يُؤَذِّنُ بِلَيْلٍ فَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّى تَسْمَعُوا أَذَانَ ابْنِ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ» ⦗ص: 164⦘ قَالَ: وَكَانَ ابْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ رَجُلًا أَعْمَى، لَا يُؤَذِّنُ حَتَّى يَقُولُ لَهُ النَّاسُ: أَذِّنْ، أَصْبَحْتَ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-'Aziz b. al-Majishun narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from Ibn 'Umar, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Bilal gives the adhan at night, so eat and drink until you hear the adhan of Ibn Umm Maktum.” [p. 164] He said: And Ibn Umm Maktum was a blind man who would not give the adhan until the people said to him: Give the adhan; it is morning.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: رَأَى عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ زَيْدٍ الْأَذَانَ فِي الْمَنَامِ، فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَهُ فَأَمَرَ بِلَالًا فَأَذَّنَ
entries.isnad_en: Zakariyya' b. Abi Za'ida narrated to us, from al-Sha'bi, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Abd Allah b. Zayd saw the adhan in a dream, and he came to the Prophet ﷺ and told him, and he ordered Bilal, who gave the adhan.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَرِهَ أَنْ يُؤَذِّنَ ⦗ص: 165⦘ الْغُلَامُ، قَبْلَ أَنْ يَحْتَلِمَ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, from 'Ata',
entries.matn_en: that he “disliked that a boy give the adhan [p. 165] before he has had a wet dream (yahtalim).”

sections.title_en: Chapter on the Adhān Without Ablution

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ مُؤَذِّنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ يُؤَذِّنُ عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us, from Mansur, who said:
entries.matn_en: Ibrahim’s mu’adhdhin used to give the adhan without being in a state of ablution.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ ثُوَيْرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَافَرْتُ مَعَ مُجَاهِدٍ فَكُنْتُ مُؤَذِّنَهُمْ، فَقَالَ لِي مُجَاهِدٌ: لَا تُؤَذِّنْ حَتَّى تَتَوَضَّأَ
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us, from Thuwayr, who said:
entries.matn_en: I travelled with Mujahid and I was their mu’adhdhin, and Mujahid said to me: Do not give the adhan until you have performed ablution.

sections.title_en: Chapter on One Who Does Not Speak During His Adhān
sections.title_ar: بَابُ مَنْ لَا يَتَكَلَّمُ فِي أَذَانِهِ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحِلٌّ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «كَانَ يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يَتَكَلَّمَ، حَتَّى يَفْرُغَ مِنْ أَذَانِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Muhill narrated to us, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “He disliked speaking until he had finished his adhan.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا يَتَكَلَّمُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ فِي أَذَانِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Sharik narrated to us, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “The mu’adhdhin does not speak during his adhan.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ مُصَرِّفٍ، عَنْ جَامِعِ بْنِ شَدَّادٍ أَبِي ⦗ص: 168⦘ صَخْرَةَ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ صُرَدَ، كَانَ يُؤَذِّنُ فِي الْعَسْكَرِ فَيَأْمُرُ غُلَامَهُ بِالْحَاجَةِ وَهُوَ فِي أَذَانِهِ
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. Talha b. Musarrif narrated to us, from Jami' b. Shaddad Abu [p. 168] Sakhra, from Musa b. 'Abd Allah b. Yazid,
entries.matn_en: that Sulayman b. Surad used to give the adhan in the army camp and would order his servant [to see to] a need while he was in the midst of his adhan.

sections.title_en: Chapter: The Mu’adhdhin Puts His Two Fingers in His Ears
sections.title_ar: بَابٌ: فِي الْمُؤَذِّنِ يَجْعَلُ إِصْبَعَيْهِ فِي أُذُنَيْهِ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي سِنَانٍ، عَنْ سَهْلٍ أَبِي أَسَدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مِنَ السُّنَّةِ أَنْ تُدْخِلَ إِصْبَعَيْكَ فِي أُذُنَيْكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Sinan, from Sahl Abu Asad, who said:
entries.matn_en: “It is part of the sunna that you put your two fingers in your ears.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعْدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: رَأَيْتُ سُوَيْدَ بْنَ غَفَلَةَ «يُدْخِلُ إِصْبَعَيْهِ فِي أُذُنَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Hasan b. Salih narrated to us, from Abu Sa'd, who said:
entries.matn_en: I saw Suwayd b. Ghafala “put his two fingers in his ears.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَبَّانُ، عَنْ مُجَالِدٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قُلْتُ: أَضَعُ أُصْبُعَيَّ فِي أُذُنِي إِذَا أَذَّنْتُ قَالَ: «نَعَمْ، كِلَاهُمَا أَوْ إِحْدَاهُمَا يُجْزِئُكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Habban narrated to us, from Mujalid, from al-Sha'bi, who said:
entries.matn_en: I said: May I put my two fingers in my ears when I give the adhan? He said: “Yes; both of them, or one of them, suffices you.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِنْدَلٌ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ أَبِي الْمُغِيرَةِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ «إِذَا أَذَّنَ جَعَلَ إِصْبَعَيْهِ فِي أُذُنَيْهِ أَوْ عَلَى أُذُنَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Mindal narrated to us, from Ja'far b. Abi al-Mughira, who said:
entries.matn_en: Sa'id b. Jubayr, “when he gave the adhan, would put his two fingers in his ears or over his ears.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعْتُ شَرِيكًا، قِيلَ لَهُ: يَجْعَلُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ إِصْبَعَهُ فِي أُذُنَيْهِ؟ قَالَ: «نَعَمْ»
entries.isnad_en: I heard Sharik, when it was said to him: Does the mu’adhdhin put his finger in his ears?
entries.matn_en: He said: “Yes.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمَاجِشُونِ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: «إِنَّ بِلَالًا يُؤَذِّنُ بِلَيْلٍ فَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّى تَسْمَعُوا أَذَانَ ابْنِ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ» وَكَانَ رَجُلًا أَعْمَى لَا يُؤَذِّنُ حَتَّى يَقُولَ لَهُ النَّاسُ: أَذِّنْ، أَصْبَحْتَ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-'Aziz b. al-Majishun narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Salim b. 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar, from his father, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Bilal gives the adhan at night, so eat and drink until you hear the adhan of Ibn Umm Maktum.” And he was a blind man who would not give the adhan until the people said to him: Give the adhan; it is morning.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَا كَانُوا يُؤَذِّنُونَ حَتَّى يُصْبِحُوا»
entries.isnad_en: Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Aswad, from 'A'isha, who said:
entries.matn_en: “They did not give the adhan until it was morning.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ بُرْقَانَ، عَنْ شَدَّادٍ، - مَوْلَى عِيَاضِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ - قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ بِلَالًا، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُؤْذِنُهُ بِصَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ، فَقَالَ: «يَا بِلَالُ، لَا تُؤَذِّنْ حَتَّى تَنْظُرَ إِلَى الْفَجْرِ هَكَذَا» ، وَقَالَ بِيَدِهِ قَالَ أَبُو ⦗ص: 171⦘ بَكْرٍ: رَوَى وَكِيع أَوْ غَيْرُهُ قَالَ: «لَا تُؤَذِّنْ بِالْفَجْرِ حَتَّى تَنْظُرَ إِلَى الْفَجْرِ هَكَذَا كَمَا يَشُقُّ الْخَيَّاطُ الثَّوْبَ» 7
entries.isnad_en: Ja'far b. Burqan narrated to us, from Shaddad—freedman of 'Iyad b. 'Amir—who said:
entries.matn_en: It reached me that Bilal came to the Prophet ﷺ to inform him of the dawn prayer, and he said: “O Bilal, do not give the adhan until you see the dawn like this,” and he gestured with his hand. Abu [p. 171] Bakr said: Waki' or another narrated: “Do not give the adhan for the dawn until you see the dawn like this, as the tailor splits the cloth.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَذَّنَ بِلَالٌ بِلَيْلٍ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: " ارْجِعْ إِلَى مَقَامِكَ فَنَادِ ثَلَاثًا: أَلَا إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ نَامَ " قَالَ: فَانْطَلَقَ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ: يَا لَيْتَ بِلَالًا لَمْ تَلِدْهُ أُمُّهُ، وَابْتَلَّ مِنْ نَضْحِ جَبِينِهِ، فَانْطَلَقَ فَنَادَى بِهَا ثَلَاثًا: أَلَا إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ نَامَ
entries.isnad_en: Sulayman b. al-Mughira narrated to us, from Humayd b. Hilal, who said:
entries.matn_en: Bilal gave the adhan at night, and the Messenger of God ﷺ said to him: “Go back to your place and call out three times: ‘Indeed, the servant has slept.’” He said: So he went off, saying: O that Bilal’s mother had not borne him!—and he was drenched with the sweat of his brow; then he went and called it out three times: Indeed, the servant has slept.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ أَبُو عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي الزَّعْرَاءِ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِمُؤَذِّنِهِ: «لَا تُؤَذِّنْ حَتَّى يَطْلُعَ الْفَجْرُ»
entries.isnad_en: Hafs Abu 'Amr narrated to us, from Abu al-Za'ra', from Abu al-Ahwas,
entries.matn_en: that he said to his mu’adhdhin: “Do not give the adhan until dawn has risen.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَمْرٍو، صَاحِبُ الْقُمُصِ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الْأَسْوَدِ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «أَذَّنْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَطْلُعَ الْفَجْرُ، فَجَاءَ قَيْسُ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ بِعَصًا فَضَرَبَنِي»
entries.isnad_en: Abu 'Amr, the man of the shirts (sahib al-qumus), narrated to us; he said: Abu al-Aswad al-Hamdani narrated to me; he said:
entries.matn_en: “I gave the adhan before dawn had risen, and Qays b. Abi Hazim came with a staff and struck me.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: لَا تُؤَذِّنْ بِالصَّلَاةِ حَتَّى يَدْخُلَ وَقْتُهَا
entries.isnad_en: Sharik narrated to us, from Muhammad b. Salim, from 'Amir, who said:
entries.matn_en: Do not give the adhan for a prayer until its time has entered.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ فُضَيْلِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ لِعَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه مُؤَذِّنٌ، فَجَعَلَ مَعَهُ مُؤَذِّنًا آخَرَ؛ لِكَيْ لَا يُؤَذِّنَ حَتَّى يَنْفَجِرَ الْفَجْرُ
entries.isnad_en: Abu Isra'il narrated to us, from Fudayl b. 'Amr, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Ali (r) had a mu’adhdhin, and he appointed another mu’adhdhin with him, in order that he would not give the adhan until the dawn had burst forth.

sections.title_en: Chapter on Measured Delivery (tarassul) in the Adhān

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مَرْحُومُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَطَّارُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، - مُؤَذِّنِ بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ - قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: جَاءَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه فَقَالَ: «إِذَا أَذَّنْتَ فَتَرَسَّلْ»
entries.isnad_en: Marhum b. 'Abd al-'Aziz al-'Attar narrated to us; he said: My father narrated to me, from Abu al-Zubayr—mu’adhdhin of Bayt al-Maqdis—who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Umar b. al-Khattab (r) came to us and said: “When you give the adhan, pace yourself (tarassal).”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ يُرَتِّلُ فِي الْأَذَانِ»
entries.isnad_en: Sharik narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Zur'a, from Ibn 'Umar,
entries.matn_en: that he “used to deliver the adhan in a measured way (yurattil).”

sections.title_en: Chapter on Those Who Used to Rush the Iqāma (yaḥdhim)

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مَرْحُومُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، - مُؤَذِّنِ بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ - قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: جَاءَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه فَقَالَ: «إِذَا أَقَمْتَ فَاحْدُرْ»
entries.isnad_en: Marhum b. 'Abd al-'Aziz narrated to us; he said: My father informed me, from Abu al-Zubayr—mu’adhdhin of Bayt al-Maqdis—who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Umar b. al-Khattab (r) came to us and said: “When you give the iqama, speed up (ihdur).”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ يَحْذِمُ الْإِقَامَةَ»
entries.isnad_en: Sharik narrated to us, from 'Uthman b. Abi al-Mughira, from Abu Ja'far, from Ibn 'Umar,
entries.matn_en: that he “used to rush through the iqama.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ حَفْصٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ «يَحْذِمُ الْإِقَامَةَ»
entries.isnad_en: Mis'ar narrated to us, from Abu Bakr b. Hafs, who said:
entries.matn_en: Ibn 'Umar “used to rush through the iqama.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on Those Who Used to Double the Adhān (yuthannī)
sections.title_ar: بَابٌ فِي مَنْ كَانَ يُثَنِّي الْأَذَانَ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ثُوَيْرٌ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: صَحِبْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ إِلَى مَكَّةَ، «فَكَانَ إِذَا أَذَّنَ ثَنَّى»
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us; he said: Thuwayr narrated to us; he said:
entries.matn_en: I accompanied Ibn 'Umar from Medina to Mecca, “and when he gave the adhan he would double [its phrases].”

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي قَائِدُ أَبِي مَحْذُورَةَ، أَنَّهُ «كَانَ أَذَانُهُ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى»
entries.isnad_en: Abu al-Ahwas narrated to us, from 'Abd al-'Aziz, who said:
entries.matn_en: The guide of Abu Mahdhura informed me that “his adhan was in pairs (mathna mathna).”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي ثُوَيْرٌ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَافَرْتُ مَعَ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ «فَكَانَ إِذَا أَذَّنَ ثَنَّى»
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us; he said: Thuwayr narrated to me; he said:
entries.matn_en: I travelled with Sa'id b. Jubayr, “and when he gave the adhan he would double [its phrases].”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ ثُوَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ مُؤَذِّنِ،
entries.matn_ar: عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه «كَانَ إِذَا أَذَّنَ ثَنَّى»
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us, from Thuwayr, from his father, from the mu’adhdhin of 'Ali (r):
entries.matn_en: “When he gave the adhan he would double [its phrases].”

sections.title_en: Chapter on One Whose Adhān Ended with “There Is No God but God”
sections.title_ar: بَابُ مَنْ كَانَ آخِرُ أَذَانِهِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " كَانَ آخِرُ أَذَانِ أَبِي مَحْذُورَةَ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ "
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Aswad, who said:
entries.matn_en: “The end of Abu Mahdhura’s adhan was: There is no god but God.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ مُحَارِبِ بْنِ دِثَارٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي الْأَسْوَدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، أَنَّ أَبَا مَحْذُورَةَ - مُؤَذِّنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ
entries.matn_ar: «آخِرَ الْأَذَانِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yunus b. Abi Ishaq narrated to us, from Muharib b. Dithar, who said: al-Aswad b. Yazid narrated to me, that Abu Mahdhura—mu’adhdhin of the Messenger of God ﷺ—narrated to him that:
entries.matn_en: “The end of the adhan is: There is no god but God.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ ذَرٍّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَتَى إِبْرَاهِيمُ أَبِي، فَصَلَّى مَعَنَا الْعَصْرَ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ مَعَ أَبِي يَمْشِيَانِ وَأَنَا مَعَهُمَا، فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبِي: يَا أَبَا عِمْرَانَ، أَيُّهُمَا آخِرُ الْأَذَانِ؟ فَقَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ: «اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Umar b. Dharr narrated to us; he said:
entries.matn_en: Ibrahim came to my father and prayed al-'Asr with us; then he went out with my father, the two of them walking and I with them, and my father said to him: O Abu 'Imran, which of them is the end of the adhan? Ibrahim said: “God is greatest, God is greatest; there is no god but God.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا كَامِلٌ أَبُو الْعَلَاءِ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا صَالِحٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا مَحْذُورَةَ، إِذَا أَذَّنَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ» قَالَ أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ: يَعْنِي يَخْتِمُ أَذَانَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Kamil Abu al-'Ala' narrated to us; he said: I heard Abu Salih; he said: I heard Abu Mahdhura, when he gave the adhan, say:
entries.matn_en: “God is greatest, God is greatest; there is no god but God.” Abu Nu'aym said: He means that he would end his adhan [with it].

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ رُفَيْعٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي قَائِدُ أَبِي مَحْذُورَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مَحْذُورَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ " كَانَ خَاتِمَةُ أَذَانِهِ: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu al-Ahwas narrated to us, from 'Abd al-'Aziz b. Rufay', who said: The guide of Abu Mahdhura informed me, from Abu Mahdhura:
entries.matn_en: that “the conclusion of his adhan was: God is greatest, God is greatest; there is no god but God.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on One Whose Adhān Ended with “God Is Greatest”
sections.title_ar: بَابُ مَنْ كَانَ آخِرُ أَذَانِهِ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي ثُوَيْرٌ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " صَحِبْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ مِنْ مَكَّةَ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ، فَكَانَ مُؤَذِّنُنَا، وَكَانَ يَجْعَلُ آخِرَ أَذَانِهِ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ "
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us; he said: Thuwayr narrated to me; he said:
entries.matn_en: “I accompanied Ibn 'Umar from Mecca to Medina, and he was our mu’adhdhin, and he would make the end of his adhan: There is no god but God, and God is greatest.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي ثُوَيْرٌ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ آخِرِ الْأَذَانِ، قَالَ: «لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ»
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us; he said: Thuwayr narrated to me; he said:
entries.matn_en: I asked Abu Ja'far about the end of the adhan; he said: “There is no god but God, and God is greatest.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَرْسَلَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ غَفَلَةَ إِلَى مُؤَذِّنِنَا رِيَاحٍ فَقَالَ: «قُلْ لَهُ يَخْتِمُ أَذَانَهُ بِلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، فَإِنَّهُ أَذَانُ بِلَالٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Zuhayr narrated to us, from 'Imran b. Muslim, who said:
entries.matn_en: Suwayd b. Ghafala sent me to our mu’adhdhin Riyah and said: “Tell him to end his adhan with ‘There is no god but God and God is greatest,’ for it is the adhan of Bilal.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي ثُوَيْرٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ مُؤَذِّنِ،
entries.matn_ar: عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه، أَنَّهُ " كَانَ إِذَا أَذَّنَ جَعَلَ آخِرَ أَذَانِهِ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ "
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us; he said: Thuwayr narrated to me, from his father, from the mu’adhdhin of 'Ali (r),
entries.matn_en: that “when he gave the adhan he would make the end of his adhan: There is no god but God, and God is greatest.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on “Prayer Is Better Than Sleep”: Those Who Used to Say It in the Dawn Prayer
sections.title_ar: بَابٌ فِي: الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ، مَنْ كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَجْلَانَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " كَانَ فِي الْأَذَانِ الْأَوَّلِ بَعْدَ الْفَلَاحِ: الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ، الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Muhammad b. 'Ajlan, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, who said:
entries.matn_en: “In the first adhan, after ‘Come to success,’ there was: Prayer is better than sleep, prayer is better than sleep.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا كَامِلٌ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا صَالِحٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا مَحْذُورَةَ، "
entries.matn_ar: إِذَا أَذَّنَ حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ: الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ، الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ "
entries.isnad_en: Kamil narrated to us; he said: I heard Abu Salih; he said: I heard Abu Mahdhura,
entries.matn_en: “when he gave the adhan—‘Come to prayer, come to success’—[say]: ‘Prayer is better than sleep, prayer is better than sleep.’”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ الْفَرَّاءِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي مَحْذُورَةَ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ، حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ، الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ، الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Ja'far al-Farra', from Abu Salman, from Abu Mahdhura, that he used to say:
entries.matn_en: “Come to prayer, come to success, prayer is better than sleep, prayer is better than sleep.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا كَيْسَانُ مَوْلَى هِشَامٍ الْقُرْدُوسِيِّ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ سِيرِينَ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ فِي أَذَانِ الْفَجْرِ»
entries.isnad_en: Kaysan, freedman of Hisham al-Qurdusi, narrated to us; he said: I heard Muhammad b. Sirin say:
entries.matn_en: “‘Prayer is better than sleep’ is [said] in the adhan of the dawn.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: سَمِعْتُ سُفْيَانَ، يَقُولُ فِي أَذَانِ الْفَجْرِ بَعْدَ الْفَلَاحِ:
entries.matn_ar: «الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ، الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ»
entries.isnad_en: I heard Sufyan say, concerning the adhan of the dawn, after ‘Come to success’:
entries.matn_en: “Prayer is better than sleep, prayer is better than sleep.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، وَهِشَامٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، - قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " جَاءَ بِلَالٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم؛ لِيَؤْذِنَهُ بِالصَّلَاةِ، فَوَجَدَهُ نَائِمًا فَقَالَ: الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ فَتُرِكَتْ فِي صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ إِلَّا أَنْ يَكُونَا اخْتَلَفَا فِي شَيْءٍ مِنَ الْمَنْطِقِ
entries.isnad_en: Hafs narrated to us, from Ash'ath, from al-Hasan, and Hisham, from his father—he said:
entries.matn_en: “Bilal came to the Prophet ﷺ to inform him of the prayer, and found him asleep, and said: Prayer is better than sleep; so it was left [in place] in the dawn prayer—unless the two [reports] differ on some point of wording.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ حَكِيمِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعَ الْأَسْوَدُ، مُؤَذِّنًا يَقُولُ: الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ، بَعْدَمَا (. . .) فَقَالَ: " وَيْحَكَ، لَا تَزْوِيْدَ فِي أَذَانِ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا، قَالَ: إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ النَّاسَ يَقُولُونَ، قَالَ: «فَلَا تَقُلْ»
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us, from Hakim b. Jubayr, from 'Imran b. Abi al-Ja'd, who said:
entries.matn_en: al-Aswad heard a mu’adhdhin say “Prayer is better than sleep,” after (. . .); and he said: “Woe to you! Do not add anything to God’s adhan.” He said: I heard the people say it. He said: “Then do not say it.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on One Who Used to Make the Tathwīb in the Dawn [Prayer]
sections.title_ar: بَابُ مَنْ كَانَ يُثَوِّبُ فِي الْفَجْرِ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسٌ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْأَعْلَى، عَنْ سُوَيْدِ بْنِ غَفَلَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ بِلَالٌ «يَحُثُّ فِي الْفَجْرِ»
entries.isnad_en: Qays narrated to us, from Ibrahim b. 'Abd al-A'la, from Suwayd b. Ghafala, who said:
entries.matn_en: Bilal “used to urge [the people] on (yahuththu) at the dawn [prayer].”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسٌ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «التَّثْوِيبُ فِي الْفَجْرِ مِنَ السُّنَّةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Qays narrated to us, from Abu Hamza, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “The tathwib at the dawn [prayer] is part of the sunna.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ سُوَيْدٍ، عَنْ بِلَالٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ يُثَوِّبُ فِي الْفَجْرِ»
entries.isnad_en: Sharik narrated to us, from 'Imran b. Muslim, from Suwayd, from Bilal,
entries.matn_en: that he “used to make the tathwib at the dawn [prayer].”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ زُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ خَيْثَمَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «كَانُوا يَثُوبُونَ فِي الْفَجْرِ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Zubayd, from Khaythama, who said:
entries.matn_en: “They used to make the tathwib at the dawn [prayer].”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْ، سَمِعَ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ أَبِي لَيْلَى، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: مَا أَحْدَثُوا بِدْعَةً أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنَ التَّثْوِيبِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from one who heard 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Layla, who said:
entries.matn_en: They have not introduced an innovation (bid'a) dearer to me than the tathwib in the prayer.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَرْسَلَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ غَفَلَةَ إِلَى مُؤَذِّنِنَا - رِيَاحٍ - فَقَالَ: قُلْ إِذَا كَانَ قَبْلَ أَوْ قَبِيلَ الْإِقَامَةِ فَلْيَقُلْ: حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ، حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ، حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ، فَإِنَّهُ أَذَانُ بِلَالٍ
entries.isnad_en: Zuhayr narrated to us, from 'Imran b. Muslim, who said:
entries.matn_en: Suwayd b. Ghafala sent me to our mu’adhdhin—Riyah—and said: Say [to him]: When it is before—or shortly before—the iqama, let him say: “Come to prayer, come to prayer, come to success,” for it is the adhan of Bilal.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ ⦗ص: 188⦘ النَّوْمِ هُوَ التَّثْوِيبُ»
entries.isnad_en: Jarir narrated to us, from Mughira, from Hammad, who said:
entries.matn_en: “‘Prayer is better than [p. 188] sleep’ is the tathwib.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ أَبِي عَزَّةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «كَانَ عَامِرٌ يَأْمُرُ مُؤَذِّنَهُ أَنْ لَا يُثَوِّبَ إِلَّا فِي الْفَجْرِ وَالْعِشَاءِ»
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us, from 'Isa b. Abi 'Azza, who said:
entries.matn_en: “'Amir used to order his mu’adhdhin not to make the tathwib except at the dawn [prayer] and al-'Isha'.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا كَامِلٌ أَبُو الْعَلَاءِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ أَبُو صَالِحٍ «يُثَوِّبُ فِي كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Kamil Abu al-'Ala' narrated to us; he said:
entries.matn_en: Abu Salih “used to make the tathwib at every prayer.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُدَيْنَةَ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ " فِي الرَّجُلِ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُؤَخِّرَ وَيُقِيمَ، قَالَ: يَرْجِعُ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Kudayna narrated to us, from Mughira, from Ibrahim, who said, concerning the man who wishes to delay and give the iqama:
entries.matn_en: He said: “He goes back.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَبَّانُ، عَنْ مُجَالِدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قُلْتُ لِلشَّعْبِيِّ: حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ، قَالَ: هَلُمَّ
entries.isnad_en: Habban narrated to us, from Mujalid, who said:
entries.matn_en: I said to al-Sha'bi: “Come to success”; he said: Halumma (“Come”).

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحِلٌّ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «كَانَ إِذَا فَرَغَ مِنَ الْإِقَامَتَيْنِ دَخَلَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ» قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: يَعْنِي إِذَا قَالَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ: قَدْ قَامَتِ الصَّلَاةُ مَرَّتَيْنِ دَخَلَ الْإِمَامُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَفْرُغَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ مِنَ الْإِقَامَةِ
entries.isnad_en: Muhill narrated to us, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “When he had finished the two [phrases of the] iqama, he entered the prayer.” Abu Bakr said: He means: when the mu’adhdhin said “The prayer has been established” twice, the imam entered the prayer before the mu’adhdhin had finished the iqama.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " كَانَ سُوَيْدُ بْنُ غَفَلَةَ جُلَّ مَا يَصْنَعُ أَنْ يُكَبِّرَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقُولَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ: قَدْ قَامَتِ الصَّلَاةُ "
entries.isnad_en: Zuhayr narrated to us, from 'Imran b. Muslim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Most of what Suwayd b. Ghafala did was to say the takbir before the mu’adhdhin said: The prayer has been established.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on One Who Is Present in the Mosque [When the Adhān Is Called]

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي عَوْنٍ، عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ - رَجُلٌ مِنْ هَمْدَانَ - قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ سَعْدٌ: إِذَا كُنْتَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَنُودِيَ بِالْأَذَانِ فَلَا تَخْرُجْ
entries.isnad_en: Mis'ar narrated to us, from Abu 'Awn, from Shurayh—a man from Hamdan—who said: Sa'd said:
entries.matn_en: When you are in the mosque and the adhan is called, do not go out.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: رَأَى أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ رَجُلًا خَرَجَ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ بَعْدَ مَا أَذَّنَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ، فَقَالَ: أَمَّا هَذَا، فَقَدْ عَصَى أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
entries.isnad_en: al-Mas'udi narrated to us, from Ash'ath b. Abi al-Sha'tha', from his father, who said:
entries.matn_en: Abu Hurayra saw a man go out of the mosque after the mu’adhdhin had given the adhan, and he said: As for this one, he has disobeyed Abu al-Qasim ﷺ.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ حَرْمَلَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: «مَنْ سَمِعَ الْمُنَادِي فَخَرَجَ فَهُوَ مُنَافِقٌ، إِلَّا رَجُلٌ خَرَجَ فِي حَاجَةٍ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Ibn Harmala, from Sa'id b. al-Musayyab, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Whoever hears the caller and goes out is a hypocrite, except a man who goes out for a need and then returns.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا سَمِعْتَ الْإِقَامَةَ، فَلَا تَخْرُجْ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Mughira, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “When you hear the iqama, do not go out.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on the Man Who Comes to the Mosque After They Have Prayed
sections.title_ar: بَابُ الرَّجُلِ يَأْتِي الْمَسْجِدَ وَقَدْ صَلُّوا

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ بُرْقَانَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ، يَأْتِي الْمَسْجِدَ وَقَدْ صَلُّوا، قَالَ: «يُقِيمُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ja'far b. Burqan narrated to us; he said:
entries.matn_en: I asked al-Zuhri about the man who comes to the mosque after they have prayed; he said: “He gives the iqama.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الشَّعْبِيَّ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا صَلَّى فِي الْمَسْجِدِ جَمَاعَةٌ، فَإِنَّ إِقَامَتَهُمْ تُجْزِئُ عَنْ مَنْ صَلَّى إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ» قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: أَظُنُّهُ قَالَ: إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ الْأُخْرَى
entries.isnad_en: Abu al-Ahwas narrated to us, from Ash'ath b. Sulaym, who said: I heard al-Sha'bi say:
entries.matn_en: “If a congregation has prayed in the mosque, their iqama suffices for whoever prays [thereafter] until the [next] prayer.” Abu Bakr said: I think he said: until the other prayer.

sections.title_en: Chapter: When You Go Out into a Desolate Tract of Land (qiyy)
sections.title_ar: بَابٌ: إِذَا خَرَجْتَ فِي قِيٍّ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ ضَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا خَرَجْتَ قِيًّا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ، أَوْ فِي قِيٍّ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ، فَتَخَيَّرْ وَأَذِّنْ وَأَقِمْ، أَوْ إِنْ شِئْتَ فَأَقِمْ»
entries.isnad_en: Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from 'Asim b. Damra, from 'Ali (r), who said:
entries.matn_en: “When you go out into a desolate tract of land, or into a desolate tract of land, you have a choice: give the adhan and give the iqama, or, if you wish, give the iqama [only].”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «صَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ بِجَمْعٍ بِإِقَامَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Salama b. Kuhayl, from Sa'id b. Jubayr, from Ibn 'Umar,
entries.matn_en: that he “prayed al-Maghrib and al-'Isha' at Jam' with a single iqama.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «أَذِّنْ وَأَقِمْ، وَإِنْ أَقَمْتَ أَجْزَأَكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Sharik narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from 'Asim, from 'Ali (r), who said:
entries.matn_en: “Give the adhan and the iqama; and if you give the iqama [only], it suffices you.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ ذَرٍّ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، «صَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ ⦗ص: 194⦘ وَالْعِشَاءَ بِجَمْعٍ، وَذَلِكَ بِإِقَامَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Umar b. Dharr narrated to us, from Mujahid,
entries.matn_en: that Ibn 'Umar “prayed al-Maghrib [p. 194] and al-'Isha' at Jam', and that was with a single iqama.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: اتَّفَقَ عَلِيٌّ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ أَنَّ «كُلَّ صَلَاةٍ بِأَذَانٍ وَإِقَامَةٍ بِجَمْعٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu al-Ahwas narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu Ja'far, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Ali and 'Abd Allah agreed that “every prayer at Jam' is with an adhan and an iqama.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ الْبَصْرِيُّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «صَلَّيْتُ خَلْفَ سَالِمٍ بِجَمْعٍ الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ بِإِقَامَتَيْنِ»
entries.isnad_en: Mis'ar narrated to us, from 'Abd al-Karim al-Basri, who said:
entries.matn_en: “I prayed behind Salim at Jam', al-Maghrib and al-'Isha', with two iqamas.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: لَقِيتُ نَافِعًا فَقُلْتُ لَهُ: كَيْفَ كَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يَصْنَعُ؟ قَالَ: هَكَذَا
entries.isnad_en: Mis'ar narrated to us, from 'Abd al-Karim, who said:
entries.matn_en: I met Nafi' and said to him: How did 'Abd Allah used to do it? He said: Like this.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: إِذَا صَلَّيْتُ لِنَفْسِكَ أَجْزَأَكَ إِقَامَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna narrated to us, from 'Ubayd Allah b. Abi Yazid, who said: I heard Jabir b. Zayd say:
entries.matn_en: When you pray for yourself, a single iqama suffices you.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا دَلْهَمُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَوْنُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، ⦗ص: 195⦘ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ فَسَمِعَ مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي بِالصَّلَاةِ، فَنَزَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصَلَّى بِأَصْحَابِهِ، وَهُوَ لَا يَرَاهُ فِي شِعْبٍ مِنْ تِلْكَ الشِّعَابِ فِي غَنَمِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Dalham b. Salih narrated to us; he said: 'Awn b. 'Abd Allah informed me, [p. 195] he said:
entries.matn_en: “The Prophet ﷺ went out one day from Medina and heard a caller calling to prayer; so the Messenger of God ﷺ dismounted and led his Companions in prayer, while the caller did not see him, in one of those ravines, among his sheep.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قُلْتُ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ: " صَلَّيْتُ فِي السَّفَرِ بِغَيْرِ إِقَامَةٍ، قَالَ: يُجْزِئُكَ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, who said:
entries.matn_en: I said to Ibrahim: “I prayed on a journey without an iqama.” He said: “It suffices you.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ إِعَادَةٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Yunus, from al-Hasan, who said:
entries.matn_en: “He does not have to repeat.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on Those Who Said: He Repeats

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «يُعِيدُ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Isma'il b. Umayya, from 'Ata', who said:
entries.matn_en: “He repeats.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، قَالَ: يُعِيدُ
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, from 'Ata', who said:
entries.matn_en: He repeats.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا طَلْحَةُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: لَا صَلَاةَ ⦗ص: 197⦘ إِلَّا بِإِقَامَةٍ
entries.isnad_en: Talha b. 'Amr narrated to us, from 'Ata', who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no prayer [p. 197] except with an iqama.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ الْبَصْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا صَلَاةَ إِلَّا بِالْإِقَامَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Mis'ar narrated to us, from 'Abd al-Karim al-Basri, from 'Ata', who said:
entries.matn_en: “There is no prayer except with the iqama.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on One Who Prayed in His House
sections.title_ar: بَابٌ فِي مَنْ صَلَّى فِي بَيْتِهِ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُهَاجِرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «رُبَّمَا صَلَّى إِبْرَاهِيمُ فِي بَيْتِهِ بِغَيْرِ أَذَانٍ وَلَا إِقَامَةٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us, from Ibrahim b. Muhajir, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Ibrahim sometimes prayed in his house without an adhan or an iqama.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا كُنْتَ فِي مِصْرٍ يُؤَذَّنُ فِيهِ أَوْ يُقَامُ، فَإِنَّ إِقَامَتَهُمْ تُجْزِئُكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu al-Ahwas narrated to us, from Husayn, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “If you are in a town (misr) in which the adhan is called or the iqama is given, their iqama suffices you.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ وَاقِدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ «لَا يُقِيمُ فِي أَرْضٍ تُقَامُ فِيهِ الصَّلَاةُ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Amr, from 'Ikrima b. Khalid, from 'Abd Allah b. Waqid, who said:
entries.matn_en: Ibn 'Umar “would not give the iqama in a place in which the prayer was [already] being held.”

sections.title_en: Chapter: The Mu’adhdhin Has More Right to the Adhān and the Imām Has More Right to the Iqāma
sections.title_ar: بَابُ الْمُؤَذِّنِ أَمْلَكُ بِالْأَذَانِ وَالْإِمَامُ أَمْلَكُ بِالْإِقَامَةِ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ هِلَالِ بْنِ يَسَافٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَوْ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، هَكَذَا قَالَ سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، رضي الله عنه:
entries.matn_ar: «الْمُؤَذِّنُ أَمْلَكُ بِالْأَذَانِ وَالْإِمَامُ أَمْلَكُ بِالْإِقَامَةِ» ⦗ص: 200⦘
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur, from Hilal b. Yasaf, from Abu 'Abd al-Rahman, or from Sa'd b. 'Ubayda, from Abu 'Abd al-Rahman—thus Sufyan said—from 'Ali (r), who said:
entries.matn_en: “The mu’adhdhin has more right to the adhan, and the imam has more right to the iqama.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ، (. . .)
entries.matn_ar: يَنْظُرُ الْإِمَامُ فِيمَا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ (. . .) الْمُؤَذِّنِ
entries.isnad_en: [p. 200] Qays narrated to us, from Muhammad b. (. . .),
entries.matn_en: (. . .) the imam considers what is between him and (. . .) the mu’adhdhin.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسٌ، (. . .) مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Qays narrated to us, (. . .)
entries.matn_en: the like of it.

sections.title_en: Chapter on People Waiting for the Imām Standing
sections.title_ar: بَابٌ فِي الْقَوْمِ يَنْتَظِرُونَ الْإِمَامَ قِيَامًا

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِيْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ، فَلَا تَقُومُوا حَتَّى تَرَوْنِي، وَعَلَيْكُمْ بِالسَّكِينَةُ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Yahya b. Abi Kathir, from 'Abd Allah b. Abi Qatada, from his father, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “When the prayer has been established, do not stand until you see me, and keep to calm (sakina).”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عِمْرَانُ بْنُ زَائِدَةَ بْنِ نَشِيطٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ أَبِي خَالِدٍ الْوَالِبِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا عَلِيٌّ وَقَدْ أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ وَهُمْ قِيَامٌ، فَقَالَ: «مَا لَكُمْ سَامِدِينَ؟»
entries.isnad_en: 'Imran b. Za'ida b. Nashit narrated to us; he said: My father informed me, from Abu Khalid al-Walibi, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Ali came out to us when the prayer had been established and they were standing, and he said: “What is the matter with you, standing stock-still (samidin)?”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ، (. . .) عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " كَانَ يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يَقُومَ الْقَوْمُ يَنْتَظِرُونَ الْإِمَامَ إِذَا أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ، وَكَانَ يُقَالُ هُوَ السُّمُودُ
entries.isnad_en: Abu al-Ahwas narrated to us, (. . .) from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “He disliked that the people stand waiting for the imam when the prayer had been established; and it used to be said: That is sumud.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا فِطْرٌ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ بْنِ نَشِيطٍ، عَنْ أَبِي خَالِدٍ الْوَالِبِيِّ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، رضي الله عنه مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ عِمْرَانَ
entries.isnad_en: Fitr narrated to us, from Za'ida b. Nashit, from Abu Khalid al-Walibi, from 'Ali (r),
entries.matn_en: the like of the hadith of 'Imran.

sections.title_en: Chapter on One Who Gave the Adhān and [Then] Led the Prayer

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ثُوَيْرٌ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: صَحِبْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ فِي سَفَرٍ، وَكَانَ مُؤَذِّنَنَا وَإِمَامَنَا
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us; he said: Thuwayr narrated to us; he said:
entries.matn_en: I accompanied Ibn 'Umar on a journey, and he was our mu’adhdhin and our imam.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ، عَنْ بَيَانٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه: لَوْ أَطَقْتُ الْأَذَانَ أَوِ التَّأْذِينَ بِالْخِلِّيفَى لَأَذَّنْتُ
entries.isnad_en: Hasan narrated to us, from Bayan, from Qays b. Abi Hazim, who said: 'Umar b. al-Khattab (r) said:
entries.matn_en: If I were able to give the adhan—or the call (ta’dhin)—along with the caliphate (al-khilliyfa), I would give the adhan.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ سُوَيْدُ بْنُ غَفَلَةَ: «لَوِ اسْتَطَعْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مُؤَذِّنَ الْحَيِّ لَفَعَلْتُ»
entries.isnad_en: Sharik narrated to us, from 'Imran, who said: Suwayd b. Ghafala said:
entries.matn_en: “If I could be the mu’adhdhin of the neighbourhood, I would do so.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ، (. . .) قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ مِنَ السُّنَّةِ أَنْ يَكُونَ إِمَامًا وَمُؤَذِّنًا ⦗ص: 204⦘
entries.isnad_en: Sharik narrated to us, from 'Imran, (. . .) he said:
entries.matn_en: “It is part of the sunna that one be both imam and mu’adhdhin.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا (. . .) عَنْ أَبِي طُعْمَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنْتُ مَعَ ابْنِ عُمَرَ فِي سَفَرٍ فَأَذَّنَ لِلْمَغْرِبِ وَأَقَامَ
entries.isnad_en: [p. 204] (. . .) narrated to us, from Abu Tu'ma, who said:
entries.matn_en: I was with Ibn 'Umar on a journey, and he gave the adhan for al-Maghrib and gave the iqama.

sections.title_en: Chapter on One Who Gave the Adhān on His Mount
sections.title_ar: بَابٌ فِي مَنْ أَذَّنَ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: (. . .) 300 - عَنْ نُسِيرٍ أَبِي طُعْمَةَ، قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ يُؤَذِّنُ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يُقِيمَ نَزَلَ 301 - حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي طُعْمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، مِثْلَهُ
entries.matn_en: [300] (. . .) from Nusayr Abu Tu'ma, who said: I saw Ibn 'Umar give the adhan on his mount, and when he wished to give the iqama he dismounted. [301] Sharik narrated to us, from Abu Tu'ma, from Ibn 'Umar, the like of it.

sections.title_en: Chapter on Those Who Said: There Is No Adhān and No Iqāma for Women
sections.title_ar: بَابٌ: فِي مَنْ قَالَ لَيْسَ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ أَذَانٌ وَلَا إِقَامَةٌ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا (. . .) عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «عَلَيْهِنَّ إِقَامَةٌ يَعْنِي النِّسَاءَ»
entries.isnad_en: (. . .) narrated to us, from 'Uthman b. al-Aswad, from Mujahid, who said:
entries.matn_en: “The iqama is required of them”—meaning, women.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، «كَانَتْ تُؤَذِّنُ وَتُقِيمُ»
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us, from Jabir, from 'Amir,
entries.matn_en: that 'A'isha “used to give the adhan and the iqama.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ جُمَيْعٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَتْنِي جَدَّتِي، عَنْ أُمِّ وَرَقَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: «أَمَرَهَا أَنْ تَؤُمَّ أَهْلَ دَارِهَا، وَكَانَ لَهَا مُؤَذِّنٌ»
entries.isnad_en: al-Walid b. Jumay' narrated to us; he said: My grandmother narrated to me, from Umm Waraqa bt. 'Abd Allah,
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet ﷺ “ordered her to lead the people of her house in prayer, and she had a mu’adhdhin.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on Those Who Said: The Mu’adhdhin Sits Between the Adhān and the Iqāma
sections.title_ar: بَابٌ: فِي مَنْ قَالَ: يَقْعُدُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ بَيْنَ الْأذَانِ وَالْإِقَامَةِ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ أَبِي الْأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «يَقْعُدُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ فِيمَا بَيْنَ الْأَذَانِ وَالْإِقَامَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Mansur b. Abi al-Aswad narrated to us, from Mughira, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “The mu’adhdhin sits between the adhan and the iqama.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا تَكُنُ أَوَّلَ الْمُؤَذِّنِينَ (. . .) »
entries.isnad_en: Hasan narrated to us, from Abu Hamza, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Do not be the first of the mu’adhdhins (. . .)”

sections.title_en: Chapter: Supplication Is Not Rejected Between the Adhān and the Iqāma
sections.title_ar: بَابٌ: لَا يُرَدُّ الدُّعَاءُ فِي مَا بَيْنَ الْأَذَانِ وَالْإِقَامَةِ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ زَيْدٍ الْعَمِّيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، رَفَعَهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَا يُرَدُّ الدُّعَاءُ فِيمَا بَيْنَ الْأَذَانِ وَالْإِقَامَةِ
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Zayd al-'Ammi, from Abu Iyas, from Anas, raising it (rafa'ahu), who said:
entries.matn_en: “Supplication is not rejected between the adhan and the iqama.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ الرَّقَاشِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا يَرُدُّ الدُّعَاءُ فِي مَا بَيْنَ الْأَذَانِ وَالْإِقَامَةِ» .
entries.isnad_en: al-Mas'udi narrated to us, from Yazid al-Raqashi, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Supplication is not rejected between the adhan and the iqama.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُمَيْسٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ يَزِيدَ الرَّقَاشِيَّ، يَذْكُرُ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَرْفَعُهُ مِثْلَهُ.
entries.isnad_en: Abu 'Umays narrated to us; he said: I heard Yazid al-Raqashi relate from Anas b. Malik, from the Prophet ﷺ, raising it,
entries.matn_en: the like of it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا نُصَيْرُ بْنُ أَبِي الْأَشْعَثِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ الرَّقَاشِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Nusayr b. Abi al-Ash'ath narrated to us, from Yazid al-Raqashi, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: the like of it.

sections.title_en: Chapter: When It Is Cloudy, What Does One Do?
sections.title_ar: بَابٌ: إِذَا كَانَ الْغَيْمُ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسٌ، عَنْ أَبِي حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ حِزَامِ بْنِ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: «إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْغَيْمِ فَعَجِّلُوا الظُّهْرَ، وَأَخِّرُوا الْإِفْطَارَ»
entries.isnad_en: Qays narrated to us, from Abu Husayn, from Hizam b. Jabir, who said: 'Abd Allah said:
entries.matn_en: “On a cloudy day, hasten al-Zuhr and delay the breaking of the fast.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ رُفَيْعٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «عَجِّلُوا صَلَاةَ الْعَصْرِ فِي يَوْمِ الْغَيْمِ»
entries.isnad_en: Hasan narrated to us, from 'Abd al-'Aziz b. Rufay', who said: The Prophet ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Hasten the 'Asr prayer on a cloudy day.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ مَاعِزٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ الرَّبِيعُ بْنُ خُثَيْمٍ إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ غَيْمٍ قَالَ لِمُؤَذِّنِهِ: «اغْسِقِ اغْسِقْ» قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: يَعْنِي أَظْلِمْ أَظْلِمْ، يَعْنِي فِي الْمَغْرِبِ
entries.isnad_en: Yunus b. Abi Ishaq narrated to us, from Bakr b. Ma'iz, who said:
entries.matn_en: When it was a cloudy day, al-Rabi' b. Khuthaym would say to his mu’adhdhin: “Ighsiq, ighsiq!”—Abu Bakr said: meaning: wait for darkness, wait for darkness; meaning, for al-Maghrib.

sections.title_en: Chapter on Praying the Dawn Prayer in the Light of Dawn (isfār)

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَجْلَانَ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ مَحْمُودِ بْنِ لَبِيدٍ، عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: «أَسْفِرُوا بِالْفَجْرِ، فَإِنَّهُ أَعْظَمُ لِلْأَجْرِ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Muhammad b. 'Ajlan, from 'Asim b. 'Umar b. Qatada, from Mahmud b. Labid, from Rafi' b. Khadij, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Pray the dawn prayer when the light has spread (asfiru bi-l-fajr), for that is greater for the reward.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا النُّعْمَانُ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَجْلَانَ، وَمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ قَتَادَةَ، ⦗ص: 214⦘ عَنْ مَحْمُودِ بْنِ لَبِيدٍ، عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. al-Mughira narrated to us; he said: al-Nu'man narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Muhammad b. 'Ajlan and Muhammad b. Ishaq, from 'Asim b. 'Umar b. Qatada, [p. 214] from Mahmud b. Labid, from Rafi' b. Khadij, from the Prophet ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: the like of it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي زَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ مَحْمُودِ بْنِ لَبِيدٍ، عَنْ رِجَالٍ،
entries.matn_ar: مِنْ قَوْمِهِ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالُوا: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَصْبِحُوا بِالْفَجْرِ، فَكُلُّ مَا أَصْبَحْتُمْ فَإِنَّهُ أَعْظَمُ لِلْأَجْرِ أَوْ لِأَجْرِكُمْ»
entries.isnad_en: Hisham b. Sa'd narrated to us; he said: Zayd b. Aslam narrated to me, from Mahmud b. Labid, from men of his people from the Companions of the Messenger of God ﷺ, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Enter the morning with the dawn prayer (asbihu bi-l-fajr); for the more you enter the morning, the greater it is for the reward—or: for your reward.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، قَالَ: كَتَبَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ إِلَى أَبِي مُوسَى: «صَلِّ الْفَجْرَ إِذَا نُوِّرَ النُّورُ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Habib b. Abi Thabit, from Nafi' b. Jubayr b. Mut'im, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Umar b. al-Khattab wrote to Abu Musa: “Pray the dawn prayer when the light has become bright.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ الطَّائِيُّ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عَلِيًّا، رضي الله عنه يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «يَا ابْنَ التَّيَّاحِ، أَسْفِرْ أَسْفِرْ بِالْفَجْرِ»
entries.isnad_en: Sa'id b. 'Ubayd al-Ta'i narrated to us, from 'Ali b. Rabi'a, who said: I heard 'Ali (r) say:
entries.matn_en: “O Ibn al-Tayyah, pray in the light, pray in the light (asfir, asfir) at dawn.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْأَوْدِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ " كَانَ يُصَلِّي مَعَ عَلِيٍّ الْفَجْرَ يُنَوَّرُ بِهَا حَتَّى نَقُولُ: الْآنَ تَطْلُعُ الشَّمْسُ "
entries.isnad_en: Dawud b. Yazid al-Awdi narrated to us, from his father,
entries.matn_en: that he “used to pray the dawn prayer with 'Ali, who would make it bright (yunawwiru) until we would say: Now the sun is rising.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي الْهَيْثَمِ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ الْأَوْدِيُّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنْتُ أُصَلِّي وَرَاءَ عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه الْغَدَاةَ، ثُمَّ أَلْتَفَتُّ فَيُخَيَّلُ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ تَطْلُعُ الشَّمْسُ
entries.isnad_en: Yahya b. Abi al-Haytham narrated to us; he said: Yazid al-Awdi narrated to us; he said:
