entries.matn_en: I used to pray the morning prayer behind 'Ali (r), then I would turn, and it would seem to me that the sun was rising.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ ⦗ص: 216⦘ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ يُسْفِرُ بِصَلَاةِ الْغَدَاةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Yazid, from [p. 216] 'Abd Allah,
entries.matn_en: that he “used to pray the morning prayer in the light (yusfiru).”

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Yazid, from 'Abd Allah,
entries.matn_en: the like of it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «كَانَ عَلِيٌّ رضي الله عنه يُسْفِرُ حَتَّى تَكَادُ الشَّمْسُ تَطْلُعُ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Layth, from a man, who said:
entries.matn_en: “'Ali (r) would pray in the light until the sun was almost rising.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «كَانُوا» يُسْفِرُونَ بِالْفَجْرِ "
entries.isnad_en: Sharik narrated to us, from Mughira, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “They used to pray the dawn prayer in the light.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَائِذِ بْنِ نُصَيْبٍ الْأَسَدِيُّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: دَخَلْتُ أَنَا وَإِبْرَاهِيمُ، مَوْمَاةً فَلَمَّا طَلَعُ الْفَجْرُ قُلْتُ: يَا أَبَا عِمْرَانَ، أَلَا تُصَلِّي؟ قَالَ: «أَسْفِرْ» ثُمَّ مَضَى غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ: قُلْتُ: أَلَا تُصَلِّي؟ قَالَ: «أَسْفِرْ»
entries.isnad_en: Hisham b. 'A'idh b. Nusayb al-Asadi narrated to us; he said:
entries.matn_en: Ibrahim and I entered a desert plain (mawmat), and when the dawn rose I said: O Abu 'Imran, will you not pray? He said: “Wait for the light.” Then he went on, not far; I said: Will you not pray? He said: “Wait for the light.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ «يُسْفِرُ بِصَلَاةِ الْغَدَاةِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Uqba b. Abi Salih narrated to us; he said:
entries.matn_en: Ibrahim “used to pray the morning prayer in the light.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عُبَيْدٍ الْمُكْتِبِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ لِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ: «نَوِّرْ نَوِّرْ» . ⦗ص: 218⦘
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Ubayd al-Muktib, who said:
entries.matn_en: Ibrahim said to me: “Make it bright, make it bright (nawwir, nawwir).”

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ: رَأَيْتُ سُفْيَانَ يُسْفِرُ بِصَلَاةِ الْغَدَاةِ
entries.matn_en: [p. 218] Abu Nu'aym said: I saw Sufyan pray the morning prayer in the light.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا نُفَاعَةُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ سُوَيْدُ بْنُ غَفَلَةَ «يُسْفِرُ بِالْفَجْرِ إِسْفَارًا شَدِيدًا»
entries.isnad_en: Nufa'a b. Muslim narrated to us; he said:
entries.matn_en: Suwayd b. Ghafala “used to pray the dawn prayer in great brightness.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ وَرْقَاءَ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: يَقُولُ لِمُؤَذِّنِهِ: «نَوِّرْ نَوِّرْ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Warqa', who said:
entries.matn_en: I heard Sa'id b. Jubayr say to his mu’adhdhin: “Make it bright, make it bright.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ شَيْخٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ الرَّبِيعُ بْنُ خُثَيْمٍ يَقُولُ لِمُؤَذِّنِهِ: نَوِّرْ نَوِّرْ
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from an old man (shaykh), who said:
entries.matn_en: al-Rabi' b. Khuthaym used to say to his mu’adhdhin: Make it bright, make it bright.

sections.title_en: Chapter on Praying the Dawn Prayer in Darkness (taghlīs)

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلْمَانَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «خَدَمْتُ الرَّكْبَ فِي زَمَنِ عُثْمَانَ رضي الله عنه فَكَانُوا يُغَلِّسُونَ حَتَّى أُصِيبَ»
entries.isnad_en: Mis'ar narrated to us, from Abu Salman, who said:
entries.matn_en: “I served the riders in the time of 'Uthman (r), and they used to pray in the darkness until [he] was struck down.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ بْنِ النُّعْمَانَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ: كَتَبَ إِلَيْنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه:
entries.matn_ar: أَنْ «صَلُّوا، الْفَجْرَ وَالْكَوَاكِبُ نَيِّرَةٌ مُشْتَبِكَةٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Mughira b. al-Nu'man, from 'Ali b. 'Amr, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Umar b. al-Khattab (r) wrote to us: “Pray the dawn prayer while the stars are bright and crowded together.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَكَنُ بْنُ أَبِي الْمُغِيرَةِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قُرِئَ عَلَيْنَا كِتَابُ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ: «صَلُّوا الْفَجْرَ بِغَلَسٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Sakan b. Abi al-Mughira narrated to us; he said:
entries.matn_en: The letter of 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz was read to us: “Pray the dawn prayer in darkness.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَيَّانَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، ⦗ص: 222⦘ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «كَانَ عُمَرُ» يُصَلِّي بِنَا الْفَجْرَ فَلَوْ كَانَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ ابْنِي ثَلَاثَةُ أَذْرُعٍ مَا عَرَفْتُهُ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Mansur b. Hayyan, from 'Amr b. Maymun, [p. 222] who said:
entries.matn_en: “'Umar used to lead us in the dawn prayer, and if there had been three cubits between me and my son, I would not have recognised him.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on One Who Prays at Times in the Light and at Times in Darkness

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَيْفُ بْنُ هَارُونَ الْبُرْجُمِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ سَلْعٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قُلْتُ لِعَبْدِ خَيْرٍ: هَلْ كَانَ عَلِيٌّ رضي الله عنه يُنَوِّرُ بِالْفَجْرِ؟ قَالَ: كَانَ يُنَوِّرُ بِهَا أَحْيَانًا وَيُغَلِّسُ بِهَا أَحْيَانًا
entries.isnad_en: Sayf b. Harun al-Burjumi narrated to us, from 'Abd al-Malik b. Sal', who said:
entries.matn_en: I said to 'Abd Khayr: Did 'Ali (r) pray the dawn prayer in the light? He said: He would pray it in the light at times and in darkness at times.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ خَرَشَةَ بْنِ الْحُرِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه يُغَلِّسُ بِالْفَجْرِ وَيُنَوِّرُ
entries.isnad_en: Abu Bakr b. 'Ayyash narrated to us, from Abu Husayn, from Kharasha b. al-Hurr, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Umar (r) used to pray the dawn prayer in darkness and in the light.

sections.title_en: Chapter on Hastening al-Ẓuhr

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ خَبَّابٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «شَكَوْنَا إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الرَّمْضَاءَ فَمَا أَشْكَانَا»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from Sa'id b. Wahb, from Khabbab, who said:
entries.matn_en: “We complained to the Prophet ﷺ of the scorching ground (ramda'), and he did not heed our complaint.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ خَبَّابٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Sharik narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from Sa'id, from Khabbab, from the Prophet ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: the like of it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ حَكِيمِ بْنِ حُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَا صَلَّى أَحَدٌ - يَعْنِي الظُّهْرَ - إِلَّا بَعْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنِ اسْتِعْجَالِهِ لَهَا» ، مَا اسْتَثْنَتْ أَبَا بَكْرٍ وَلَا عُمَرَ
entries.isnad_en: Isra'il narrated to us, from Hakim b. Jubayr, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from 'A'isha, who said:
entries.matn_en: “No one hastened it—meaning al-Zuhr—as the Messenger of God ﷺ did.” She did not except Abu Bakr or 'Umar.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، قَالَ: كَتَبَ عُمَرُ إِلَى أَبِي مُوسَى:
entries.matn_ar: أَنْ «صَلِّ الظُّهْرَ، إِذَا زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ وَأَبْرِدْ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Habib b. Abi Thabit, from Nafi' b. Jubayr b. Mut'im, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Umar wrote to Abu Musa: “Pray al-Zuhr when the sun has declined, and wait for it to cool (abrid).”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ النُّعْمَانَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ: كَتَبَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه إِلَيْنَا: "
entries.matn_ar: أَنْ صَلُّوا الظُّهْرَ إِذَا زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ عَنْ وَسَطِ السَّمَاءِ
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from al-Mughira b. al-Nu'man, from 'Ali b. 'Amr, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Umar b. al-Khattab (r) wrote to us: “Pray al-Zuhr when the sun has declined from the middle of the sky.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ خِشْفِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ: ⦗ص: 226⦘
entries.matn_ar: «كَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يُصَلِّي بِنَا الظُّهْرَ، وَإِنَّ الْجَنَادِبَ تَنَاقَزُ فِي الرَّمْضَاءِ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Zayd b. Jubayr, from Khishf b. Malik, who said:
entries.matn_en: [p. 226] “'Abd Allah used to lead us in al-Zuhr while the grasshoppers were leaping about on the scorching ground.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَنَشُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُدْرِكٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ سُوَيْدٌ يُؤَذِّنُ بِالْهَاجِرَةِ، فَسَمِعَهُ الْحَجَّاجُ، وَهُوَ فِي الدَّيْرِ فَقَالَ: ائْتُونِي بِهَذَا الْمُؤَذِّنِ، فَأُتِيَ بِسُوَيْدِ بْنِ غَفَلَةَ، فَقَالَ: مَا حَمَلَكَ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ بِالْهَاجِرَةِ؟ قَالَ: «صَلَّيْتُهَا مَعَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ» ، قَالَ: لَا تُؤَذِّنْ لِقَوْمِكَ، وَلَا تَؤُمَّهُمْ
entries.isnad_en: Hanash b. al-Harith narrated to us, from 'Ali b. Mudrik, who said:
entries.matn_en: Suwayd used to give the adhan at midday heat, and al-Hajjaj heard him while he was in the monastery (dayr) and said: Bring me this mu’adhdhin. Suwayd b. Ghafala was brought, and he said: What made you pray in the midday heat? He said: “I prayed it with Abu Bakr and 'Umar.” He said: Do not give the adhan for your people, and do not lead them in prayer.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا نُفَاعَةُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَرْسَلَ الْحَجَّاجُ إِلَى سُوَيْدِ بْنِ غَفَلَةَ فِي صَلَاةِ الظُّهْرِ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْهَا: مَا هَذِهِ الصَّلَاةُ الَّتِي تُصَلِّيْهَا هَذِهِ السَّاعَةَ؟ قَالَ: «صَلَّيْتُهَا مَعَ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه»
entries.isnad_en: Nufa'a b. Muslim narrated to us; he said:
entries.matn_en: al-Hajjaj sent for Suwayd b. Ghafala at the time of the al-Zuhr prayer and asked him about it: What is this prayer that you pray at this hour? He said: “I prayed it with 'Umar b. al-Khattab (r).”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ يُصَلِّي مَعَ عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه حِينَ تَزُولُ الشَّمْسُ»
entries.isnad_en: Dawud b. Yazid narrated to us, from his father,
entries.matn_en: that he “used to pray with 'Ali (r) when the sun declined.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا نُفَاعَةُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ سُوَيْدُ بْنُ غَفَلَةَ يُصَلِّي الظُّهْرَ عِنْدَ زَوَالِ الشَّمْسِ
entries.isnad_en: Nufa'a b. Muslim narrated to us; he said:
entries.matn_en: Suwayd b. Ghafala used to pray al-Zuhr at the declining of the sun.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حُرَيْثُ بْنُ السَّائِبِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ الْحَسَنَ عَنْ وَقْتِ، صَلَاةِ الظُّهْرِ، قَالَ: «إِذَا رَأَيْتَ الْفَيْءَ قَدْ زَالَ عَنْ طُولِ الشَّيْءِ إِلَى الشَّيْءِ فَذَاكَ حِينَ يُصَلَّى الظُّهْرُ»
entries.isnad_en: Hurayth b. al-Sa'ib narrated to us; he said:
entries.matn_en: I asked al-Hasan about the time of the al-Zuhr prayer. He said: “When you see that the shade has moved from the length of a thing toward the thing, that is when al-Zuhr is prayed.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حُرَيْثٌ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ سِيرِينَ، فَقَالَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ
entries.isnad_en: Hurayth narrated to us; he said:
entries.matn_en: I asked Ibn Sirin, and he said the like of that.
